ayahs.ar: الٓمّٓصٓۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Alif-Laaam-Meeem-Saaad
ayahs.en: Alif, Lam, Meem, Sad.

ayahs.ar: كِتٰبٌ اُنۡزِلَ اِلَيۡكَ فَلَا يَكُنۡ فِيۡ صَدۡرِكَ حَرَجٌ مِّنۡهُ لِتُنۡذِرَ بِهٖ وَذِكۡرٰي لِلۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Kitaabun unzila ilaika falaa yakum fee sadrika harajum minhu litunzira bihee wa zikraa lilmu'mineen
ayahs.en: [This is] a Book revealed to you, [O Muhammad] - so let there not be in your breast distress therefrom - that you may warn thereby and as a reminder to the believers.

ayahs.ar: اِتَّبِعُوۡا مَا٘ اُنۡزِلَ اِلَيۡكُمۡ مِّنۡ رَّبِّكُمۡ وَلَا تَتَّبِعُوۡا مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ٘ اَوۡلِيَآءَؕ قَلِيۡلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Ittabi'oo maaa unzila 'ilaikum mir Rabbikum wa laa tattabi'oo min dooniheee awliyaaa'; qaleelam maa tazakkaroon
ayahs.en: Follow, [O mankind], what has been revealed to you from your Lord and do not follow other than Him any allies. Little do you remember.

ayahs.ar: وَكَمۡ مِّنۡ قَرۡيَةٍ اَهۡلَكۡنٰهَا فَجَآءَهَا بَاۡسُنَا بَيَاتًا اَوۡ هُمۡ قَآئِلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa kam min qaryatin ahlaknaahaa fajaaa'ahaa baasunaa bayaatan aw hum qaaa'iloon
ayahs.en: And how many cities have We destroyed, and Our punishment came to them at night or while they were sleeping at noon.

ayahs.ar: فَمَا كَانَ دَعۡوٰىهُمۡ اِذۡ جَآءَهُمۡ بَاۡسُنَا٘ اِلَّا٘ اَنۡ قَالُوۡ٘ا اِنَّا كُنَّا ظٰلِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Famaa kaana da'waahum iz jaaa'ahum baasunaa illaaa an qaalooo innaa kunnaa zaalimeen
ayahs.en: And their declaration when Our punishment came to them was only that they said, "Indeed, we were wrongdoers!"

ayahs.ar: فَلَنَسۡـَٔلَنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ اُرۡسِلَ اِلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَنَسۡـَٔلَنَّ الۡمُرۡسَلِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Falanas 'alannal lazeena ursila ilaihim wa lanas 'alannal mursaleen
ayahs.en: Then We will surely question those to whom [a message] was sent, and We will surely question the messengers.

ayahs.ar: فَلَنَقُصَّنَّ عَلَيۡهِمۡ بِعِلۡمٍ وَّمَا كُنَّا غَآئِبِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Falanaqussanna 'alaihim bi'ilminw wa maa kunnaa ghaaa'ibeen
ayahs.en: Then We will surely relate [their deeds] to them with knowledge, and We were not [at all] absent.

ayahs.ar: وَالۡوَزۡنُ يَوۡمَئِذِ اِۨلۡحَقُّۚ فَمَنۡ ثَقُلَتۡ مَوَازِيۡنُهٗ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الۡمُفۡلِحُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Walwaznu Yawma'izinil haqq; faman saqulat mawaa zeenuhoo fa-ulaaa'ika humul muflihoon
ayahs.en: And the weighing [of deeds] that Day will be the truth. So those whose scales are heavy - it is they who will be the successful.

ayahs.ar: وَمَنۡ خَفَّتۡ مَوَازِيۡنُهٗ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِيۡنَ خَسِرُوۡ٘ا اَنۡفُسَهُمۡ بِمَا كَانُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِنَا يَظۡلِمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa man khaffat mawaazeenuhoo fa ulaaa'ikal lazeena khasirooo anfusahum bimaa kaanoo bi Aayaatinaa yazlimoon
ayahs.en: And those whose scales are light - they are the ones who will lose themselves for what injustice they were doing toward Our verses.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ مَكَّنّٰكُمۡ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَجَعَلۡنَا لَكُمۡ فِيۡهَا مَعَايِشَؕ قَلِيۡلًا مَّا تَشۡكُرُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad makkannaakum fil ardi wa ja'alnaa lakum feehaa ma'aayish; qaleelam maa tashkuroon
ayahs.en: And We have certainly established you upon the earth and made for you therein ways of livelihood. Little are you grateful.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنٰكُمۡ ثُمَّ صَوَّرۡنٰكُمۡ ثُمَّ قُلۡنَا لِلۡمَلٰٓئِكَةِ اسۡجُدُوۡا لِاٰدَمَࣗۖ فَسَجَدُوۡ٘ا اِلَّا٘ اِبۡلِيۡسَؕ لَمۡ يَكُنۡ مِّنَ السّٰجِدِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad khalaqnaakum summa sawwarnaakum summa qulnaa lilmalaaa'ikatis judoo li Aadama fa-sajadooo illaaa Ibleesa lam yakum minas saajideen
ayahs.en: And We have certainly created you, [O Mankind], and given you [human] form. Then We said to the angels, "Prostrate to Adam"; so they prostrated, except for Iblees. He was not of those who prostrated.

ayahs.ar: قَالَ مَا مَنَعَكَ اَلَّا تَسۡجُدَ اِذۡ اَمَرۡتُكَؕ قَالَ اَنَا خَيۡرٌ مِّنۡهُۚ خَلَقۡتَنِيۡ مِنۡ نَّارٍ وَّخَلَقۡتَهٗ مِنۡ طِيۡنٍ
ayahs.tl: Qaala maa mana'aka allaa tasjuda iz amartuka qaala ana khairum minhu khalaqtanee min naarinw wa khalaqtahoo min teen
ayahs.en: [Allah] said, "What prevented you from prostrating when I commanded you?" [Satan] said, "I am better than him. You created me from fire and created him from clay."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَاهۡبِطۡ مِنۡهَا فَمَا يَكُوۡنُ لَكَ اَنۡ تَتَكَبَّرَ فِيۡهَا فَاخۡرُجۡ اِنَّكَ مِنَ الصّٰغِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala fahbit minhaa famaa yakoonu laka an tatakabbara feehaa fakhruj innaka minas saaghireen
ayahs.en: [Allah] said, "Descend from Paradise, for it is not for you to be arrogant therein. So get out; indeed, you are of the debased.

ayahs.ar: قَالَ اَنۡظِرۡنِيۡ٘ اِلٰي يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala anzirneee ilaa Yawmi yub'asoon
ayahs.en: [Satan] said, "Reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ اِنَّكَ مِنَ الۡمُنۡظَرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala innaka minal munzareen
ayahs.en: [Allah] said, "Indeed, you are of those reprieved."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَبِمَا٘ اَغۡوَيۡتَنِيۡ لَاَقۡعُدَنَّ لَهُمۡ صِرَاطَكَ الۡمُسۡتَقِيۡمَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaala fabimaaa aghway tanee la aq'udanna lahum Siraatakal Mustaqeem
ayahs.en: [Satan] said, "Because You have put me in error, I will surely sit in wait for them on Your straight path.

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ لَاٰتِيَنَّهُمۡ مِّنۭۡ بَيۡنِ اَيۡدِيۡهِمۡ وَمِنۡ خَلۡفِهِمۡ وَعَنۡ اَيۡمَانِهِمۡ وَعَنۡ شَمَآئِلِهِمۡؕ وَلَا تَجِدُ اَكۡثَرَهُمۡ شٰكِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Summa la aatiyannahum mim baine aideehim wa min khalfihim wa 'an aimaanihim wa 'an shamaaa'ilihim wa laa tajidu aksarahum shaakireen
ayahs.en: Then I will come to them from before them and from behind them and on their right and on their left, and You will not find most of them grateful [to You]."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ اخۡرُجۡ مِنۡهَا مَذۡءُوۡمًا مَّدۡحُوۡرًاؕ لَمَنۡ تَبِعَكَ مِنۡهُمۡ لَاَمۡلَـَٔنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنۡكُمۡ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaalakh ruj mnhaa maz'oomam madhooraa; laman tabi'aka minhum la amla'anna Jahannama minkum ajma'een
ayahs.en: [Allah] said, "Get out of Paradise, reproached and expelled. Whoever follows you among them - I will surely fill Hell with you, all together."

ayahs.ar: وَيٰ٘اٰدَمُ اسۡكُنۡ اَنۡتَ وَزَوۡجُكَ الۡجَنَّةَ فَكُلَا مِنۡ حَيۡثُ شِئۡتُمَا وَلَا تَقۡرَبَا هٰذِهِ الشَّجَرَةَ فَتَكُوۡنَا مِنَ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa yaaa Aadamus kun anta wa zawjukal Jannata fakulaa min haisu shi'tumaa wa laa taqrabaa haazihish shajarata fatakoonaa minza zaalimeen
ayahs.en: And "O Adam, dwell, you and your wife, in Paradise and eat from wherever you will but do not approach this tree, lest you be among the wrongdoers."

ayahs.ar: فَوَسۡوَسَ لَهُمَا الشَّيۡطٰنُ لِيُبۡدِيَ لَهُمَا مَا وٗرِيَ عَنۡهُمَا مِنۡ سَوۡاٰتِهِمَا وَقَالَ مَا نَهٰىكُمَا رَبُّكُمَا عَنۡ هٰذِهِ الشَّجَرَةِ اِلَّا٘ اَنۡ تَكُوۡنَا مَلَكَيۡنِ اَوۡ تَكُوۡنَا مِنَ الۡخٰلِدِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fawaswasa lahumash Shaitaanu liyubdiya lahumaa maa wooriya 'anhumaa min saw aatihimaa wa qaala maa nahaakumaa Rabbukumaa 'an haazihish shajarati illaaa an takoonaa malakaini aw takoonaa minal khaalideen
ayahs.en: But Satan whispered to them to make apparent to them that which was concealed from them of their private parts. He said, "Your Lord did not forbid you this tree except that you become angels or become of the immortal."

ayahs.ar: وَقَاسَمَهُمَا٘ اِنِّيۡ لَكُمَا لَمِنَ النّٰصِحِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa qaasamahumaaa innee lakumaa laminan naasiheen
ayahs.en: And he swore [by Allah] to them, "Indeed, I am to you from among the sincere advisors."

ayahs.ar: فَدَلّٰىهُمَا بِغُرُوۡرٍۚ فَلَمَّا ذَاقَا الشَّجَرَةَ بَدَتۡ لَهُمَا سَوۡاٰتُهُمَا وَطَفِقَا يَخۡصِفٰنِ عَلَيۡهِمَا مِنۡ وَّرَقِ الۡجَنَّةِؕ وَنَادٰىهُمَا رَبُّهُمَا٘ اَلَمۡ اَنۡهَكُمَا عَنۡ تِلۡكُمَا الشَّجَرَةِ وَاَقُلۡ لَّكُمَا٘ اِنَّ الشَّيۡطٰنَ لَكُمَا عَدُوٌّ مُّبِيۡنٌ
ayahs.tl: Fadallaahumaa bighuroor; falammaa zaaqash shajarata badat lahumaa saw aatuhumaa wa tafiqaa yakhsifaani 'alaihimaa minw waraqil jannati wa naadaahumaa Rabbuhumaaa alam anhakumaa 'an tilkumash shajarati wa aqul lakumaaa innash Shaitaana lakumaa 'aduwwum mubeen
ayahs.en: So he made them fall, through deception. And when they tasted of the tree, their private parts became apparent to them, and they began to fasten together over themselves from the leaves of Paradise. And their Lord called to them, "Did I not forbid you from that tree and tell you that Satan is to you a clear enemy?"

ayahs.ar: قَالَا رَبَّنَا ظَلَمۡنَا٘ اَنۡفُسَنَاࣝ وَاِنۡ لَّمۡ تَغۡفِرۡ لَنَا وَتَرۡحَمۡنَا لَنَكُوۡنَنَّ مِنَ الۡخٰسِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaalaa Rabbanaa zalamnaaa anfusanaa wa illam taghfir lanaa wa tarhamnaa lanakoonanna minal khaasireen
ayahs.en: They said, "Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ اهۡبِطُوۡا بَعۡضُكُمۡ لِبَعۡضٍ عَدُوٌّۚ وَلَكُمۡ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ مُسۡتَقَرٌّ وَّمَتَاعٌ اِلٰي حِيۡنٍ
ayahs.tl: Qaalah bitoo ba'dukum liba'din aduwwunw wa lakum fil ardi mmustaqarrunw wa mataa'un ilaaheen
ayahs.en: [Allah] said, "Descend, being to one another enemies. And for you on the earth is a place of settlement and enjoyment for a time."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فِيۡهَا تَحۡيَوۡنَ وَفِيۡهَا تَمُوۡتُوۡنَ وَمِنۡهَا تُخۡرَجُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaala feehaa tahyawna wa feehaa tamootoona wa minhaa tukhrajoon
ayahs.en: He said, "Therein you will live, and therein you will die, and from it you will be brought forth."

ayahs.ar: يٰبَنِيۡ٘ اٰدَمَ قَدۡ اَنۡزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكُمۡ لِبَاسًا يُّوَارِيۡ سَوۡاٰتِكُمۡ وَرِيۡشًاؕ وَلِبَاسُ التَّقۡوٰي ذٰلِكَ خَيۡرٌؕ ذٰلِكَ مِنۡ اٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَذَّكَّرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Yaa Baneee Aadama qad anzalnaa 'alaikum libaasany yuwaaree saw aatikum wa reeshanw wa libaasut taqwaa zaalika khair; zaalika min Aayaatil laahi la'allahum yaz zakkaroon
ayahs.en: O children of Adam, We have bestowed upon you clothing to conceal your private parts and as adornment. But the clothing of righteousness - that is best. That is from the signs of Allah that perhaps they will remember.

ayahs.ar: يٰبَنِيۡ٘ اٰدَمَ لَا يَفۡتِنَنَّكُمُ الشَّيۡطٰنُ كَمَا٘ اَخۡرَجَ اَبَوَيۡكُمۡ مِّنَ الۡجَنَّةِ يَنۡزِعُ عَنۡهُمَا لِبَاسَهُمَا لِيُرِيَهُمَا سَوۡاٰتِهِمَاؕ اِنَّهٗ يَرٰىكُمۡ هُوَ وَقَبِيۡلُهٗ مِنۡ حَيۡثُ لَا تَرَوۡنَهُمۡؕ اِنَّا جَعَلۡنَا الشَّيٰطِيۡنَ اَوۡلِيَآءَ لِلَّذِيۡنَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Yaa Banee Aadama laa yaftinannnakumush Shaitaanu kamaaa akhraja abawaikum minal Jannati yanzi'u 'anhumaa libaasahumaa liyuriyahumaa saw aatihimaaa; innahoo yaraakum huwa wa qabeeluhoo min haisu laa tarawnahum; innaa ja'alnash Shayaateena awliyaaa'a lillazeena laa yu'minoon
ayahs.en: O children of Adam, let not Satan tempt you as he removed your parents from Paradise, stripping them of their clothing to show them their private parts. Indeed, he sees you, he and his tribe, from where you do not see them. Indeed, We have made the devils allies to those who do not believe.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذَا فَعَلُوۡا فَاحِشَةً قَالُوۡا وَجَدۡنَا عَلَيۡهَا٘ اٰبَآءَنَا وَاللّٰهُ اَمَرَنَا بِهَاؕ قُلۡ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يَاۡمُرُ بِالۡفَحۡشَآءِؕ اَتَقُوۡلُوۡنَ عَلَي اللّٰهِ مَا لَا تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa izaa fa'aloo faahishatan qaaloo wajadnaa 'alaihaaa aabaaa'ana wallaahu amaranaa bihaa; qul innal laaha laa yaamuru bilfahshaaa'i a-taqooloona 'alal laahi mmaa laa ta'lamoon
ayahs.en: And when they commit an immorality, they say, "We found our fathers doing it, and Allah has ordered us to do it." Say, "Indeed, Allah does not order immorality. Do you say about Allah that which you do not know?"

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ اَمَرَ رَبِّيۡ بِالۡقِسۡطِࣞ وَاَقِيۡمُوۡا وُجُوۡهَكُمۡ عِنۡدَ كُلِّ مَسۡجِدٍ وَّادۡعُوۡهُ مُخۡلِصِيۡنَ لَهُ الدِّيۡنَ ࣢ؕ كَمَا بَدَاَكُمۡ تَعُوۡدُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Qul amara Rabbee bilqisti wa aqeemoo wujoohakum 'inda kulli masjidin wad'oohu mukhliseena lahud deen; kamaa bada akum ta'oodoon
ayahs.en: Say, [O Muhammad], "My Lord has ordered justice and that you maintain yourselves [in worship of Him] at every place [or time] of prostration, and invoke Him, sincere to Him in religion." Just as He originated you, you will return [to life] -

ayahs.ar: فَرِيۡقًا هَدٰي وَفَرِيۡقًا حَقَّ عَلَيۡهِمُ الضَّلٰلَةُؕ اِنَّهُمُ اتَّخَذُوا الشَّيٰطِيۡنَ اَوۡلِيَآءَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ وَيَحۡسَبُوۡنَ اَنَّهُمۡ مُّهۡتَدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fareeqan hadaa wa fareeqan haqqa 'alaihimud dalaalah; innahumut takhazush Shayaateena awliyaaa'a min doonil laahi wa yahsaboona annnahum muhtadoon
ayahs.en: A group [of you] He guided, and a group deserved [to be in] error. Indeed, they had taken the devils as allies instead of Allah while they thought that they were guided.

ayahs.ar: يٰبَنِيۡ٘ اٰدَمَ خُذُوۡا زِيۡنَتَكُمۡ عِنۡدَ كُلِّ مَسۡجِدٍ وَّكُلُوۡا وَاشۡرَبُوۡا وَلَا تُسۡرِفُوۡاۚؕ اِنَّهٗ لَا يُحِبُّ الۡمُسۡرِفِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Yaa Banneee Adama khuzoo zeenatakum 'inda kulli masjidinw wa kuloo washraboo wa laa tusrifoo; innahoo laa yuhibbul musrifeen
ayahs.en: O children of Adam, take your adornment at every masjid, and eat and drink, but be not excessive. Indeed, He likes not those who commit excess.

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ مَنۡ حَرَّمَ زِيۡنَةَ اللّٰهِ الَّتِيۡ٘ اَخۡرَجَ لِعِبَادِهٖ وَالطَّيِّبٰتِ مِنَ الرِّزۡقِؕ قُلۡ هِيَ لِلَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا فِي الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَا خَالِصَةً يَّوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِؕ كَذٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ الۡاٰيٰتِ لِقَوۡمٍ يَّعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qul man harrama zeenatal laahil lateee akhraja li'ibaadihee wattaiyibaati minar rizq; qul hiya lillazeena aamanoo fil hayaatid dunyaa khaalisatany Yawmal Qiyaamah; kazaalika nufassihul Aayaati liqawminy ya'lamoon
ayahs.en: Say, "Who has forbidden the adornment of Allah which He has produced for His servants and the good [lawful] things of provision?" Say, "They are for those who believe during the worldly life [but] exclusively for them on the Day of Resurrection." Thus do We detail the verses for a people who know.

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ اِنَّمَا حَرَّمَ رَبِّيَ الۡفَوَاحِشَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنۡهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ وَالۡاِثۡمَ وَالۡبَغۡيَ بِغَيۡرِ الۡحَقِّ وَاَنۡ تُشۡرِكُوۡا بِاللّٰهِ مَا لَمۡ يُنَزِّلۡ بِهٖ سُلۡطٰنًا وَّاَنۡ تَقُوۡلُوۡا عَلَي اللّٰهِ مَا لَا تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qul innamaa harrama Rabbiyal fawaahisha maa zahara minhaa wa maa bataa wal isma walbaghya bighairil haqqi wa an tushrikoo billaahi maa lam yunazzil bihee sultaananw wa an taqooloo 'alal laahi maa laa ta'lamoon
ayahs.en: Say, "My Lord has only forbidden immoralities - what is apparent of them and what is concealed - and sin, and oppression without right, and that you associate with Allah that for which He has not sent down authority, and that you say about Allah that which you do not know."

ayahs.ar: وَلِكُلِّ اُمَّةٍ اَجَلٌۚ فَاِذَا جَآءَ اَجَلُهُمۡ لَا يَسۡتَاۡخِرُوۡنَ سَاعَةً وَّلَا يَسۡتَقۡدِمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa likulli ummatin ajalun fa izaa jaaa'a ajaluhum laa yastaakhiroona saa'atanw wa laa yastaqdimoon
ayahs.en: And for every nation is a [specified] term. So when their time has come, they will not remain behind an hour, nor will they precede [it].

ayahs.ar: يٰبَنِيۡ٘ اٰدَمَ اِمَّا يَاۡتِيَنَّكُمۡ رُسُلٌ مِّنۡكُمۡ يَقُصُّوۡنَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ اٰيٰتِيۡۙ فَمَنِ اتَّقٰي وَاَصۡلَحَ فَلَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يَحۡزَنُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: yaa Banee Aadama immaa yaatiyannakum Rusulum minkum yaqussoona 'alaikum Aayaatee famanit taqaa wa aslaha falaa khawfun 'alaihim wa laa hum yahzanoon
ayahs.en: O children of Adam, if there come to you messengers from among you relating to you My verses, then whoever fears Allah and reforms - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ كَذَّبُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِنَا وَاسۡتَكۡبَرُوۡا عَنۡهَا٘ اُولٰٓئِكَ اَصۡحٰبُ النَّارِۚ هُمۡ فِيۡهَا خٰلِدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wallazeena kazzaboo bi Aayaatinaa wastakbaroo 'anhhaaa ulaaa'ika Ashaabun naari hum feehaa khaalidoon
ayahs.en: But the ones who deny Our verses and are arrogant toward them - those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally.

ayahs.ar: فَمَنۡ اَظۡلَمُ مِمَّنِ افۡتَرٰي عَلَي اللّٰهِ كَذِبًا اَوۡ كَذَّبَ بِاٰيٰتِهٖؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ يَنَالُهُمۡ نَصِيۡبُهُمۡ مِّنَ الۡكِتٰبِؕ حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا جَآءَتۡهُمۡ رُسُلُنَا يَتَوَفَّوۡنَهُمۡۙ قَالُوۡ٘ا اَيۡنَ مَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَدۡعُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِؕ قَالُوۡا ضَلُّوۡا عَنَّا وَشَهِدُوۡا عَلٰ٘ي اَنۡفُسِهِمۡ اَنَّهُمۡ كَانُوۡا كٰفِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Faman azlamu mimmanif taraa 'alal laahi kaziban aw kazzaba bi Aayaatih; ulaaa'ika yanaaluhum naseebuhum minal Kitaab; hataaa izaa jaaa'at hum rusulunaa yatawaf fawnahum qaalooo aina maa kuntum tad'oonaa min doonil laahi qaaloo dalloo 'annaa wa shahidoo 'alaaa anfusihim annahum kaanoo kaafieen
ayahs.en: And who is more unjust than one who invents about Allah a lie or denies His verses? Those will attain their portion of the decree until when Our messengers come to them to take them in death, they will say, "Where are those you used to invoke besides Allah?" They will say, "They have departed from us," and will bear witness against themselves that they were disbelievers.

ayahs.ar: قَالَ ادۡخُلُوۡا فِيۡ٘ اُمَمٍ قَدۡ خَلَتۡ مِنۡ قَبۡلِكُمۡ مِّنَ الۡجِنِّ وَالۡاِنۡسِ فِي النَّارِؕ كُلَّمَا دَخَلَتۡ اُمَّةٌ لَّعَنَتۡ اُخۡتَهَاؕ حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا ادَّارَكُوۡا فِيۡهَا جَمِيۡعًاۙ قَالَتۡ اُخۡرٰىهُمۡ لِاُوۡلٰىهُمۡ رَبَّنَا هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ اَضَلُّوۡنَا فَاٰتِهِمۡ عَذَابًا ضِعۡفًا مِّنَ النَّارِ ࣢ؕ قَالَ لِكُلٍّ ضِعۡفٌ وَّلٰكِنۡ لَّا تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaalad khuloo feee umamin qad khalat min qablikum minal jinni wal insifin naari kullamaa dakhalat ummatul la'anat ukhtahaa hattaaa izad daarakoo feehaa jamee'an qaalat ukhraahum li oolaahum Rabbannaa haaa'u laaa'i adalloonaa fa aatihim 'azaaban di'fam minan naari qaala likullin di funw wa laakil laa ta'lamoon
ayahs.en: [Allah] will say, "Enter among nations which had passed on before you of jinn and mankind into the Fire." Every time a nation enters, it will curse its sister until, when they have all overtaken one another therein, the last of them will say about the first of them "Our Lord, these had misled us, so give them a double punishment of the Fire. He will say, "For each is double, but you do not know."

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَتۡ اُوۡلٰىهُمۡ لِاُخۡرٰىهُمۡ فَمَا كَانَ لَكُمۡ عَلَيۡنَا مِنۡ فَضۡلٍ فَذُوۡقُوا الۡعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَكۡسِبُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa qaalat oolaahum li ukhraahum famaa kaana lakum 'alainaa min fadlin fazooqul azaaba bimaa kuntum taksiboon
ayahs.en: And the first of them will say to the last of them, "Then you had not any favor over us, so taste the punishment for what you used to earn."

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ كَذَّبُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِنَا وَاسۡتَكۡبَرُوۡا عَنۡهَا لَا تُفَتَّحُ لَهُمۡ اَبۡوَابُ السَّمَآءِ وَلَا يَدۡخُلُوۡنَ الۡجَنَّةَ حَتّٰي يَلِجَ الۡجَمَلُ فِيۡ سَمِّ الۡخِيَاطِؕ وَكَذٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي الۡمُجۡرِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Innal lazeena kazzaboo bi Aayaatinaa wastakbaroo 'anhaa laa tufattahu lahum ahwaabus samaaa'i wa laa yadkhuloonal jannata hattaa yalijal jamalu fee sammil khiyaat; wa kazaalika najzil mujrimeen
ayahs.en: Indeed, those who deny Our verses and are arrogant toward them - the gates of Heaven will not be opened for them, nor will they enter Paradise until a camel enters into the eye of a needle. And thus do We recompense the criminals.

ayahs.ar: لَهُمۡ مِّنۡ جَهَنَّمَ مِهَادٌ وَّمِنۡ فَوۡقِهِمۡ غَوَاشٍؕ وَكَذٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Lahum min jahannama mihaadunw wa min fawqihim ghawaash; wa kazaalika najziz zaalimeen
ayahs.en: They will have from Hell a bed and over them coverings [of fire]. And thus do We recompense the wrongdoers.

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ لَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفۡسًا اِلَّا وُسۡعَهَا٘ؗ اُولٰٓئِكَ اَصۡحٰبُ الۡجَنَّةِۚ هُمۡ فِيۡهَا خٰلِدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wallazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati la nukallifu nafsan illaa wus'ahaaa ulaaa'ika Ashaabul jannati hum feehaa khaalidoon
ayahs.en: But those who believed and did righteous deeds - We charge no soul except [within] its capacity. Those are the companions of Paradise; they will abide therein eternally.

ayahs.ar: وَنَزَعۡنَا مَا فِيۡ صُدُوۡرِهِمۡ مِّنۡ غِلٍّ تَجۡرِيۡ مِنۡ تَحۡتِهِمُ الۡاَنۡهٰرُۚ وَقَالُوا الۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيۡ هَدٰىنَا لِهٰذَاࣞ وَمَا كُنَّا لِنَهۡتَدِيَ لَوۡلَا٘ اَنۡ هَدٰىنَا اللّٰهُۚ لَقَدۡ جَآءَتۡ رُسُلُ رَبِّنَا بِالۡحَقِّؕ وَنُوۡدُوۡ٘ا اَنۡ تِلۡكُمُ الۡجَنَّةُ اُوۡرِثۡتُمُوۡهَا بِمَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa naza'naa maa fee sudoorihim min ghillin tajree min tahtihimul anhaaru wa qaalul hamdu lillaahil lazee hadaanaa lihaaza wa maa kunna linahtadiya law laaa ann hadaanal laahu laqad jaaa'at Rusulu Rabbinaa bilhaqq; wa noodoo an tilkumul jannnatu ooristumoohaa bimaa kuntum ta'maloon
ayahs.en: And We will have removed whatever is within their breasts of resentment, [while] flowing beneath them are rivers. And they will say, "Praise to Allah, who has guided us to this; and we would never have been guided if Allah had not guided us. Certainly the messengers of our Lord had come with the truth." And they will be called, "This is Paradise, which you have been made to inherit for what you used to do."

ayahs.ar: وَنَادٰ٘ي اَصۡحٰبُ الۡجَنَّةِ اَصۡحٰبَ النَّارِ اَنۡ قَدۡ وَجَدۡنَا مَا وَعَدَنَا رَبُّنَا حَقًّا فَهَلۡ وَجَدۡتُّمۡ مَّا وَعَدَ رَبُّكُمۡ حَقًّاؕ قَالُوۡا نَعَمۡۚ فَاَذَّنَ مُؤَذِّنٌۭ بَيۡنَهُمۡ اَنۡ لَّعۡنَةُ اللّٰهِ عَلَي الظّٰلِمِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa naadaa Ashaabul jannati ashaaban Naari an qad wajadnaa maa wa'adannaa Rabbunaa haqqan fahal wajattum maa wa'ada Rabbukum haqqan qaaloo na'am; fa azzana mu'azzinum bainahum al la'natul laahi 'alaz zaalimeen
ayahs.en: And the companions of Paradise will call out to the companions of the Fire, "We have already found what our Lord promised us to be true. Have you found what your Lord promised to be true?" They will say, "Yes." Then an announcer will announce among them, "The curse of Allah shall be upon the wrongdoers."

ayahs.ar: الَّذِيۡنَ يَصُدُّوۡنَ عَنۡ سَبِيۡلِ اللّٰهِ وَيَبۡغُوۡنَهَا عِوَجًاۚ وَهُمۡ بِالۡاٰخِرَةِ كٰفِرُوۡنَۘ‏
ayahs.tl: Allazeena yasuddoona 'an sabeelil laahi wa yabghoo nahaa 'iwajanw wa hum bil Aakhirati kaafiroon
ayahs.en: Who averted [people] from the way of Allah and sought to make it [seem] deviant while they were, concerning the Hereafter, disbelievers.

ayahs.ar: وَبَيۡنَهُمَا حِجَابٌۚ وَعَلَي الۡاَعۡرَافِ رِجَالٌ يَّعۡرِفُوۡنَ كُلًّاۭ بِسِيۡمٰىهُمۡۚ وَنَادَوۡا اَصۡحٰبَ الۡجَنَّةِ اَنۡ سَلٰمٌ عَلَيۡكُمۡࣞ لَمۡ يَدۡخُلُوۡهَا وَهُمۡ يَطۡمَعُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa bainahumaa hijaab; wa 'alal A'raafi rijaaluny ya'rifoona kullam biseemaahum; wa naadaw Ashaabal jannati an salaamun 'alaikum; lam yadkhuloohaa wa hum yatma'oon
ayahs.en: And between them will be a partition, and on [its] elevations are men who recognize all by their mark. And they call out to the companions of Paradise, "Peace be upon you." They have not [yet] entered it, but they long intensely.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذَا صُرِفَتۡ اَبۡصَارُهُمۡ تِلۡقَآءَ اَصۡحٰبِ النَّارِۙ قَالُوۡا رَبَّنَا لَا تَجۡعَلۡنَا مَعَ الۡقَوۡمِ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa izaa surifat absaaruhum tilqaaa'a Ashaabin Naari qaalo Rabbanaa laa taj'alnaa ma'al qawmiz zaalimneen
ayahs.en: And when their eyes are turned toward the companions of the Fire, they say, "Our Lord, do not place us with the wrongdoing people."

ayahs.ar: وَنَادٰ٘ي اَصۡحٰبُ الۡاَعۡرَافِ رِجَالًا يَّعۡرِفُوۡنَهُمۡ بِسِيۡمٰىهُمۡ قَالُوۡا مَا٘ اَغۡنٰي عَنۡكُمۡ جَمۡعُكُمۡ وَمَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَسۡتَكۡبِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa naadaaa Ashaabul A'raffi rijaalany ya'rifoonahum biseemaahum qaaloo maaa aghnaa 'ankum jam'ukum wa maa kuntum tastakbiroon
ayahs.en: And the companions of the Elevations will call to men [within Hell] whom they recognize by their mark, saying, "Of no avail to you was your gathering and [the fact] that you were arrogant."

ayahs.ar: اَهٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ الَّذِيۡنَ اَقۡسَمۡتُمۡ لَا يَنَالُهُمُ اللّٰهُ بِرَحۡمَةٍؕ اُدۡخُلُوا الۡجَنَّةَ لَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَلَا٘ اَنۡتُمۡ تَحۡزَنُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: A haaa'ulaaa'il lazeena aqsamtum laa yanaaluhumul laahu birahma; udkhulul Jannata laa khawfun 'alaikum wa laaa antum tahzanoon
ayahs.en: [Allah will say], "Are these the ones whom you [inhabitants of Hell] swore that Allah would never offer them mercy? Enter Paradise, [O People of the Elevations]. No fear will there be concerning you, nor will you grieve."

ayahs.ar: وَنَادٰ٘ي اَصۡحٰبُ النَّارِ اَصۡحٰبَ الۡجَنَّةِ اَنۡ اَفِيۡضُوۡا عَلَيۡنَا مِنَ الۡمَآءِ اَوۡ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ اللّٰهُؕ قَالُوۡ٘ا اِنَّ اللّٰهَ حَرَّمَهُمَا عَلَي الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa naadaaa Ashaabun Naari Ashaabal jannati an afeedoo 'alainaa minal maaa'i aw mimma razaqakumul laah; qaaloo innal laaha harrama humaa 'alal kaafireen
ayahs.en: And the companions of the Fire will call to the companions of Paradise, "Pour upon us some water or from whatever Allah has provided you." They will say, "Indeed, Allah has forbidden them both to the disbelievers."

ayahs.ar: الَّذِيۡنَ اتَّخَذُوۡا دِيۡنَهُمۡ لَهۡوًا وَّلَعِبًا وَّغَرَّتۡهُمُ الۡحَيٰوةُ الدُّنۡيَاۚ فَالۡيَوۡمَ نَنۡسٰىهُمۡ كَمَا نَسُوۡا لِقَآءَ يَوۡمِهِمۡ هٰذَاۙ وَمَا كَانُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِنَا يَجۡحَدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Allazeenat takhazoo deenahu lahwanw wa la'i-banw wa gharrat humul hayaatud dunyaa; fal Yawma nnannsaahum kamaa nasoo liqaaa'a Yawmihim haazaa wa maa kaanoo bi aayaatinaa yajhadoon
ayahs.en: Who took their religion as distraction and amusement and whom the worldly life deluded." So today We will forget them just as they forgot the meeting of this Day of theirs and for having rejected Our verses.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ جِئۡنٰهُمۡ بِكِتٰبٍ فَصَّلۡنٰهُ عَلٰي عِلۡمٍ هُدًي وَّرَحۡمَةً لِّقَوۡمٍ يُّؤۡمِنُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad ji'naahum bi Kitaabin fassalnaahu 'alaa 'ilmin hudanw wa rahmatal liqawminy-yu'miinoon
ayahs.en: And We had certainly brought them a Book which We detailed by knowledge - as guidance and mercy to a people who believe.

ayahs.ar: هَلۡ يَنۡظُرُوۡنَ اِلَّا تَاۡوِيۡلَهٗؕ يَوۡمَ يَاۡتِيۡ تَاۡوِيۡلُهٗ يَقُوۡلُ الَّذِيۡنَ نَسُوۡهُ مِنۡ قَبۡلُ قَدۡ جَآءَتۡ رُسُلُ رَبِّنَا بِالۡحَقِّۚ فَهَلۡ لَّنَا مِنۡ شُفَعَآءَ فَيَشۡفَعُوۡا لَنَا٘ اَوۡ نُرَدُّ فَنَعۡمَلَ غَيۡرَ الَّذِيۡ كُنَّا نَعۡمَلُؕ قَدۡ خَسِرُوۡ٘ا اَنۡفُسَهُمۡ وَضَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا يَفۡتَرُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: hal yanzuroona illaa taa weelah; yawma yaatee taaweeluhoo yaqoolul lazeena nasoohu min qablu qad jaaa'at Rusulu Rabbinaa bilhaqq; fahal lanaa min shufa'aaa'a fa yashfa'oo lanaaa aw nuraddu fana'mala ghairal lazee kunnaa na'mal; qad khasirooo anfusahum wa dalla 'anhum maa kaanoo yaftaroon
ayahs.en: Do they await except its result? The Day its result comes those who had ignored it before will say, "The messengers of our Lord had come with the truth, so are there [now] any intercessors to intercede for us or could we be sent back to do other than we used to do?" They will have lost themselves, and lost from them is what they used to invent.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ اللّٰهُ الَّذِيۡ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ فِيۡ سِتَّةِ اَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسۡتَوٰي عَلَي الۡعَرۡشِࣞ يُغۡشِي الَّيۡلَ النَّهَارَ يَطۡلُبُهٗ حَثِيۡثًاۙ وَّالشَّمۡسَ وَالۡقَمَرَ وَالنُّجُوۡمَ مُسَخَّرٰتٍۭ بِاَمۡرِهٖؕ اَلَا لَهُ الۡخَلۡقُ وَالۡاَمۡرُؕ تَبٰرَكَ اللّٰهُ رَبُّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Inna Rabbakkumul laahul lazee khalaqas sammaawaati wal arda fee sittati qiyaamin summmas tawaa 'alal 'arshi yughshil lailan nahaara yatlu buhoo haseesanw washshamsa walqamara wannujooma musakhkharaatim bi amrih; alaa lahul khalqu wal-amr; tabaarakal laahu Rabbul 'aalameen
ayahs.en: Indeed, your Lord is Allah, who created the heavens and earth in six days and then established Himself above the Throne. He covers the night with the day, [another night] chasing it rapidly; and [He created] the sun, the moon, and the stars, subjected by His command. Unquestionably, His is the creation and the command; blessed is Allah, Lord of the worlds.

ayahs.ar: اُدۡعُوۡا رَبَّكُمۡ تَضَرُّعًا وَّخُفۡيَةًؕ اِنَّهٗ لَا يُحِبُّ الۡمُعۡتَدِيۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Ud'oo Rabbakum tadarru'anw wa khufyah; innahoo laa yuhibbul mu'tadeen
ayahs.en: Call upon your Lord in humility and privately; indeed, He does not like transgressors.

ayahs.ar: وَلَا تُفۡسِدُوۡا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ بَعۡدَ اِصۡلَاحِهَا وَادۡعُوۡهُ خَوۡفًا وَّطَمَعًاؕ اِنَّ رَحۡمَتَ اللّٰهِ قَرِيۡبٌ مِّنَ الۡمُحۡسِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa laa tufsidoo fil ardi ba'da islaahihaa wad'oohu khawfanw wa tama'aa; inna rahmatal laahi qareebum minal muhsineen
ayahs.en: And cause not corruption upon the earth after its reformation. And invoke Him in fear and aspiration. Indeed, the mercy of Allah is near to the doers of good.

ayahs.ar: وَهُوَ الَّذِيۡ يُرۡسِلُ الرِّيٰحَ بُشۡرًاۭ بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡ رَحۡمَتِهٖؕ حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا٘ اَقَلَّتۡ سَحَابًا ثِقَالًا سُقۡنٰهُ لِبَلَدٍ مَّيِّتٍ فَاَنۡزَلۡنَا بِهِ الۡمَآءَ فَاَخۡرَجۡنَا بِهٖ مِنۡ كُلِّ الثَّمَرٰتِؕ كَذٰلِكَ نُخۡرِجُ الۡمَوۡتٰي لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَذَكَّرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa Huwal lazee yursilur riyaaha bushram baina yadai rahmatihee hattaaa izaaa aqallat sahaaban siqaalan suqnaahu libaladim maiyitin fa annzalnaa bihil maaa'a fa akhrajnaa bihee minn kullis samaraat; kazaalika nukhrijul mawtaa la'allakum tazakkaroon
ayahs.en: And it is He who sends the winds as good tidings before His mercy until, when they have carried heavy rainclouds, We drive them to a dead land and We send down rain therein and bring forth thereby [some] of all the fruits. Thus will We bring forth the dead; perhaps you may be reminded.

ayahs.ar: وَالۡبَلَدُ الطَّيِّبُ يَخۡرُجُ نَبَاتُهٗ بِاِذۡنِ رَبِّهٖۚ وَالَّذِيۡ خَبُثَ لَا يَخۡرُجُ اِلَّا نَكِدًاؕ كَذٰلِكَ نُصَرِّفُ الۡاٰيٰتِ لِقَوۡمٍ يَّشۡكُرُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Walbaladut taiyibu yakhruju nabaatuhoo bi-izni Rabbihee wallazee khabusa laa yakhruju illaa nakidaa; kazaalika nusarriful Aayaati liqawminy yashkuroon
ayahs.en: And the good land - its vegetation emerges by permission of its Lord; but that which is bad - nothing emerges except sparsely, with difficulty. Thus do We diversify the signs for a people who are grateful.

ayahs.ar: لَقَدۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا نُوۡحًا اِلٰي قَوۡمِهٖ فَقَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اعۡبُدُوا اللّٰهَ مَا لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ اِلٰهٍ غَيۡرُهٗؕ اِنِّيۡ٘ اَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيۡمٍ
ayahs.tl: Laqad arsalnaa noohan ilaa qawmihee faqaala yaa qawmi' budul laaha maa lakum min ilaahin ghairuhoo inneee akhaafu 'alaikum 'azaaba Yawmin 'Azeem
ayahs.en: We had certainly sent Noah to his people, and he said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him. Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a tremendous Day.

ayahs.ar: قَالَ الۡمَلَاُ مِنۡ قَوۡمِهٖ٘ اِنَّا لَنَرٰىكَ فِيۡ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ
ayahs.tl: Qaalal mala-u min qaw miheee innaa lanaraaka fee dalaalim mubeen
ayahs.en: Said the eminent among his people, "Indeed, we see you in clear error."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ لَيۡسَ بِيۡ ضَلٰلَةٌ وَّلٰكِنِّيۡ رَسُوۡلٌ مِّنۡ رَّبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala yaa qawmi laisa bee dalaalatunw wa laakinnee Rasoolum mir Rabbil 'aalameen
ayahs.en: [Noah] said, "O my people, there is not error in me, but I am a messenger from the Lord of the worlds."

ayahs.ar: اُبَلِّغُكُمۡ رِسٰلٰتِ رَبِّيۡ وَاَنۡصَحُ لَكُمۡ وَاَعۡلَمُ مِنَ اللّٰهِ مَا لَا تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Uballighukum Risaalaati Rabbee wa ansahu lakum wa a'lamu minal laahi maa laa ta'lamoon
ayahs.en: I convey to you the messages of my Lord and advise you; and I know from Allah what you do not know.

ayahs.ar: اَوَعَجِبۡتُمۡ اَنۡ جَآءَكُمۡ ذِكۡرٌ مِّنۡ رَّبِّكُمۡ عَلٰي رَجُلٍ مِّنۡكُمۡ لِيُنۡذِرَكُمۡ وَلِتَتَّقُوۡا وَلَعَلَّكُمۡ تُرۡحَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: awa'ajibtum an jaaa'akum zikrum mir Rabbikum 'alaa rajulim minkum liyunzirakum wa litattaqoo wa la'allakum turhamoon
ayahs.en: Then do you wonder that there has come to you a reminder from your Lord through a man from among you, that he may warn you and that you may fear Allah so you might receive mercy."

ayahs.ar: فَكَذَّبُوۡهُ فَاَنۡجَيۡنٰهُ وَالَّذِيۡنَ مَعَهٗ فِي الۡفُلۡكِ وَاَغۡرَقۡنَا الَّذِيۡنَ كَذَّبُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِنَاؕ اِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوۡا قَوۡمًا عَمِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Fakazzaboohu fa anjai naahu wallazeena ma'ahoo fil fulki wa aghraqnal lazeena kazzaboo bi Aayaatinaa; innahum kaanoo qawman 'ameen
ayahs.en: But they denied him, so We saved him and those who were with him in the ship. And We drowned those who denied Our signs. Indeed, they were a blind people.

ayahs.ar: وَاِلٰي عَادٍ اَخَاهُمۡ هُوۡدًاؕ قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اعۡبُدُوا اللّٰهَ مَا لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ اِلٰهٍ غَيۡرُهٗؕ اَفَلَا تَتَّقُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa ilaa 'aadin akhaahum Hoodaa; qaala yaa qawmi' budul laaha maa lakum min ilaahin ghairuh; afalaa tattaqoon
ayahs.en: And to the 'Aad [We sent] their brother Hud. He said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him. Then will you not fear Him?"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ الۡمَلَاُ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا مِنۡ قَوۡمِهٖ٘ اِنَّا لَنَرٰىكَ فِيۡ سَفَاهَةٍ وَّاِنَّا لَنَظُنُّكَ مِنَ الۡكٰذِبِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaalal mala ul lazeena kafaroo min qawmiheee innaa lanaraaka fee safaahatinw wa innaa lannazunnuka minal kaazibeen
ayahs.en: Said the eminent ones who disbelieved among his people, "Indeed, we see you in foolishness, and indeed, we think you are of the liars."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ لَيۡسَ بِيۡ سَفَاهَةٌ وَّلٰكِنِّيۡ رَسُوۡلٌ مِّنۡ رَّبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala yaa qawmi laisa bee safaahatunw wa laakinnee Rasoolum mir Rabbil 'aalameen
ayahs.en: [Hud] said, "O my people, there is not foolishness in me, but I am a messenger from the Lord of the worlds."

ayahs.ar: اُبَلِّغُكُمۡ رِسٰلٰتِ رَبِّيۡ وَاَنَا لَكُمۡ نَاصِحٌ اَمِيۡنٌ
ayahs.tl: Uballighukum Risaalaati Rabbee wa ana lakum naasihun ameen
ayahs.en: I convey to you the messages of my Lord, and I am to you a trustworthy adviser.

ayahs.ar: اَوَعَجِبۡتُمۡ اَنۡ جَآءَكُمۡ ذِكۡرٌ مِّنۡ رَّبِّكُمۡ عَلٰي رَجُلٍ مِّنۡكُمۡ لِيُنۡذِرَكُمۡؕ وَاذۡكُرُوۡ٘ا اِذۡ جَعَلَكُمۡ خُلَفَآءَ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ قَوۡمِ نُوۡحٍ وَّزَادَكُمۡ فِي الۡخَلۡقِ بَصۜۡطَةًۚ فَاذۡكُرُوۡ٘ا اٰلَآءَ اللّٰهِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُفۡلِحُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: awa 'ajibtum an jaaa'akum zikrum mir Rabbikum 'alaa rajulim minkum liyunzirakum; wazkurooo iz ja'alakum khulafaaa'a mim ba'di qawmi noohinw wa zaadakum filkhalqi bastatan fazkurooo aalaaa'al laahi la'allakum tuflihoon
ayahs.en: Then do you wonder that there has come to you a reminder from your Lord through a man from among you, that he may warn you? And remember when He made you successors after the people of Noah and increased you in stature extensively. So remember the favors of Allah that you might succeed.

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡ٘ا اَجِئۡتَنَا لِنَعۡبُدَ اللّٰهَ وَحۡدَهٗ وَنَذَرَ مَا كَانَ يَعۡبُدُ اٰبَآؤُنَاۚ فَاۡتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَا٘ اِنۡ كُنۡتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaalooo aji'tanaa lina'budal laaha wahdahoo wa nazara maa kaana ya'budu aabaaa'u naa faatinaa bimaa ta'idunaaa in kunta minas saadiqeen
ayahs.en: They said, "Have you come to us that we should worship Allah alone and leave what our fathers have worshipped? Then bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the truthful."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ قَدۡ وَقَعَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ مِّنۡ رَّبِّكُمۡ رِجۡسٌ وَّغَضَبٌؕ اَتُجَادِلُوۡنَنِيۡ فِيۡ٘ اَسۡمَآءٍ سَمَّيۡتُمُوۡهَا٘ اَنۡتُمۡ وَاٰبَآؤُكُمۡ مَّا نَزَّلَ اللّٰهُ بِهَا مِنۡ سُلۡطٰنٍؕ فَانۡتَظِرُوۡ٘ا اِنِّيۡ مَعَكُمۡ مِّنَ الۡمُنۡتَظِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala qad waqa'a alaikum mir Rabbikum rijsunw wa ghadab, atujaadiloonanee feee asmaaa'in sammaitumoohaaa antum wa aabaaa'ukum maa nazzalal laahu bihaa min sultaan; fantazirooo innee ma'akum minal muntazireen
ayahs.en: [Hud] said, "Already have defilement and anger fallen upon you from your Lord. Do you dispute with me concerning [mere] names you have named them, you and your fathers, for which Allah has not sent down any authority? Then wait; indeed, I am with you among those who wait."

ayahs.ar: فَاَنۡجَيۡنٰهُ وَالَّذِيۡنَ مَعَهٗ بِرَحۡمَةٍ مِّنَّا وَقَطَعۡنَا دَابِرَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَذَّبُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِنَا وَمَا كَانُوۡا مُؤۡمِنِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Fa anjainaahu wallazeena ma'ahoo birahmatim minnaa wa qata'naa daabiral lazeena kazzaboo bi Aayaatinaa wa maa kaanoo mu'mineen
ayahs.en: So We saved him and those with him by mercy from Us. And We eliminated those who denied Our signs, and they were not [at all] believers.

ayahs.ar: وَاِلٰي ثَمُوۡدَ اَخَاهُمۡ صٰلِحًاۘ قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اعۡبُدُوا اللّٰهَ مَا لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ اِلٰهٍ غَيۡرُهٗؕ قَدۡ جَآءَتۡكُمۡ بَيِّنَةٌ مِّنۡ رَّبِّكُمۡؕ هٰذِهٖ نَاقَةُ اللّٰهِ لَكُمۡ اٰيَةً فَذَرُوۡهَا تَاۡكُلۡ فِيۡ٘ اَرۡضِ اللّٰهِ وَلَا تَمَسُّوۡهَا بِسُوۡٓءٍ فَيَاۡخُذَكُمۡ عَذَابٌ اَلِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa ilaa Samooda akhaahum Saalihaa; qaala yaa qawmi' budul laaha maa lakum min ilaahin ghairuhoo qad jaaa'atkum baiyinatum mir Rabbikum haazihee naaqatul laahi lakum Aayatan fazaroohaa taakul feee ardil laahi wa laa tamassoohaa bisooo'in fa yaakhuzakum 'azaabun aleem
ayahs.en: And to the Thamud [We sent] their brother Salih. He said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him. There has come to you clear evidence from your Lord. This is the she-camel of Allah [sent] to you as a sign. So leave her to eat within Allah 's land and do not touch her with harm, lest there seize you a painful punishment.

ayahs.ar: وَاذۡكُرُوۡ٘ا اِذۡ جَعَلَكُمۡ خُلَفَآءَ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ عَادٍ وَّبَوَّاَكُمۡ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ تَتَّخِذُوۡنَ مِنۡ سُهُوۡلِهَا قُصُوۡرًا وَّتَنۡحِتُوۡنَ الۡجِبَالَ بُيُوۡتًاۚ فَاذۡكُرُوۡ٘ا اٰلَآءَ اللّٰهِ وَلَا تَعۡثَوۡا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ مُفۡسِدِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wazkkurooo iz ja'alakum khulafaaa'a mim ba'di 'Aadinw wa bawwa akum fil ardi tattakhizoona min suhoolihaa qusooranw wa tanhitoonal jibaala buyootan fazkurooo aalaaa'al laahi wa laa ta'saw fil ardi mufsideen
ayahs.en: And remember when He made you successors after the 'Aad and settled you in the land, [and] you take for yourselves palaces from its plains and carve from the mountains, homes. Then remember the favors of Allah and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ الۡمَلَاُ الَّذِيۡنَ اسۡتَكۡبَرُوۡا مِنۡ قَوۡمِهٖ لِلَّذِيۡنَ اسۡتُضۡعِفُوۡا لِمَنۡ اٰمَنَ مِنۡهُمۡ اَتَعۡلَمُوۡنَ اَنَّ صٰلِحًا مُّرۡسَلٌ مِّنۡ رَّبِّهٖؕ قَالُوۡ٘ا اِنَّا بِمَا٘ اُرۡسِلَ بِهٖ مُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaalal mala ul lazeenas takbaroo min qawmihee lillazeenas tud'ifoo liman aamana minhum ata'almoona anna Saaliham mursalum mir Rabbih; qaalooo innaa bimaaa ursila bihee mu'minoon
ayahs.en: Said the eminent ones who were arrogant among his people to those who were oppressed - to those who believed among them, "Do you [actually] know that Salih is sent from his Lord?" They said, "Indeed we, in that with which he was sent, are believers."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ اسۡتَكۡبَرُوۡ٘ا اِنَّا بِالَّذِيۡ٘ اٰمَنۡتُمۡ بِهٖ كٰفِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaalal lazeenas takbarooo innaa billazeee aamanntum bihee kaafiroon
ayahs.en: Said those who were arrogant, "Indeed we, in that which you have believed, are disbelievers."

ayahs.ar: فَعَقَرُوا النَّاقَةَ وَعَتَوۡا عَنۡ اَمۡرِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَقَالُوۡا يٰصٰلِحُ ائۡتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَا٘ اِنۡ كُنۡتَ مِنَ الۡمُرۡسَلِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fa'aqarun naaqata wa'ataw 'an amri Rabbihim wa qaaloo yaa Saalihu' tinaa bimaa ta'idunaaa in kunta minal mursaleen
ayahs.en: So they hamstrung the she-camel and were insolent toward the command of their Lord and said, "O Salih, bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the messengers."

ayahs.ar: فَاَخَذَتۡهُمُ الرَّجۡفَةُ فَاَصۡبَحُوۡا فِيۡ دَارِهِمۡ جٰثِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fa akhazat humur rajftu fa asbahoo fee daarihim jaasimmeen
ayahs.en: So the earthquake seized them, and they became within their home [corpses] fallen prone.

ayahs.ar: فَتَوَلّٰي عَنۡهُمۡ وَقَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ لَقَدۡ اَبۡلَغۡتُكُمۡ رِسَالَةَ رَبِّيۡ وَنَصَحۡتُ لَكُمۡ وَلٰكِنۡ لَّا تُحِبُّوۡنَ النّٰصِحِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fa tawalla 'anhum wa qaala yaa qawmi laqad ablaghtukum Risaalata Rabbee wa nasahtu lakum wa laakil laa tuhibboonan naasiheen
ayahs.en: And he turned away from them and said, "O my people, I had certainly conveyed to you the message of my Lord and advised you, but you do not like advisors."

ayahs.ar: وَلُوۡطًا اِذۡ قَالَ لِقَوۡمِهٖ٘ اَتَاۡتُوۡنَ الۡفَاحِشَةَ مَا سَبَقَكُمۡ بِهَا مِنۡ اَحَدٍ مِّنَ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa Lootan iz qaala liqawmiheee ataatoonal faahishata maa sabaqakum bihaa min ahadim minal 'aalameen
ayahs.en: And [We had sent] Lot when he said to his people, "Do you commit such immorality as no one has preceded you with from among the worlds?

ayahs.ar: اِنَّكُمۡ لَتَاۡتُوۡنَ الرِّجَالَ شَهۡوَةً مِّنۡ دُوۡنِ النِّسَآءِؕ بَلۡ اَنۡتُمۡ قَوۡمٌ مُّسۡرِفُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Innakum lataatoonar rijaala shahwatam min doonin nisaaa'; bal antumqawmum musrifoon
ayahs.en: Indeed, you approach men with desire, instead of women. Rather, you are a transgressing people."

ayahs.ar: وَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوۡمِهٖ٘ اِلَّا٘ اَنۡ قَالُوۡ٘ا اَخۡرِجُوۡهُمۡ مِّنۡ قَرۡيَتِكُمۡۚ اِنَّهُمۡ اُنَاسٌ يَّتَطَهَّرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa maa kaana jawaaba qawmihee illaa an qaalooo akhrijoohum min qaryatikum innahum unaasuny yatatah haroon
ayahs.en: But the answer of his people was only that they said, "Evict them from your city! Indeed, they are men who keep themselves pure."

ayahs.ar: فَاَنۡجَيۡنٰهُ وَاَهۡلَهٗ٘ اِلَّا امۡرَاَتَهٗؗۖ كَانَتۡ مِنَ الۡغٰبِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fa anjainaahu wa ahlahooo illam ra atahoo kaanat minal ghaabireen
ayahs.en: So We saved him and his family, except for his wife; she was of those who remained [with the evildoers].

ayahs.ar: وَاَمۡطَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ مَّطَرًاؕ فَانۡظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الۡمُجۡرِمِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa 'amtarnaa 'alaihim mataran fanzur kaifa kaana aaqibatul mujjrimeen
ayahs.en: And We rained upon them a rain [of stones]. Then see how was the end of the criminals.

ayahs.ar: وَاِلٰي مَدۡيَنَ اَخَاهُمۡ شُعَيۡبًاؕ قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اعۡبُدُوا اللّٰهَ مَا لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ اِلٰهٍ غَيۡرُهٗؕ قَدۡ جَآءَتۡكُمۡ بَيِّنَةٌ مِّنۡ رَّبِّكُمۡ فَاَوۡفُوا الۡكَيۡلَ وَالۡمِيۡزَانَ وَلَا تَبۡخَسُوا النَّاسَ اَشۡيَآءَهُمۡ وَلَا تُفۡسِدُوۡا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ بَعۡدَ اِصۡلَاحِهَاؕ ذٰلِكُمۡ خَيۡرٌ لَّكُمۡ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنِيۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa ilaa Madyana akhaahum Shu'aybaa; qaala yaa qawmi' budul laaha maa lakum min ilaahin ghairuhoo qad jaaa'atkum baiyinatum mir Rabbikum fa awful kaila walmeezaana wa laa tabkhasun naasa ashyaa'ahum wa laa tufsidoo fil ardi ba'da islaahihaa; zaalikum khairul lakum in kuntum mu'mineen
ayahs.en: And to [the people of] Madyan [We sent] their brother Shu'ayb. He said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him. There has come to you clear evidence from your Lord. So fulfill the measure and weight and do not deprive people of their due and cause not corruption upon the earth after its reformation. That is better for you, if you should be believers.

ayahs.ar: وَلَا تَقۡعُدُوۡا بِكُلِّ صِرَاطٍ تُوۡعِدُوۡنَ وَتَصُدُّوۡنَ عَنۡ سَبِيۡلِ اللّٰهِ مَنۡ اٰمَنَ بِهٖ وَتَبۡغُوۡنَهَا عِوَجًاۚ وَاذۡكُرُوۡ٘ا اِذۡ كُنۡتُمۡ قَلِيۡلًا فَكَثَّرَكُمۡࣕ وَانۡظُرُوۡا كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الۡمُفۡسِدِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa laa taq'udoo bikulli siraatin too'idoona wa tasuddoona 'an sabeelil laahi man aamana bihee wa abghoonahaa 'iwajaa; waz kurooo iz kuntum qaleelan fakassarakum wanzuroo kaifa kaana 'aaqibatul mufsideen
ayahs.en: And do not sit on every path, threatening and averting from the way of Allah those who believe in Him, seeking to make it [seem] deviant. And remember when you were few and He increased you. And see how was the end of the corrupters.

ayahs.ar: وَاِنۡ كَانَ طَآئِفَةٌ مِّنۡكُمۡ اٰمَنُوۡا بِالَّذِيۡ٘ اُرۡسِلۡتُ بِهٖ وَطَآئِفَةٌ لَّمۡ يُؤۡمِنُوۡا فَاصۡبِرُوۡا حَتّٰي يَحۡكُمَ اللّٰهُ بَيۡنَنَاۚ وَهُوَ خَيۡرُ الۡحٰكِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa In kaana taaa'ifatum minkum aamanoo billazeee ursiltu bihee wa taaa'ifatul lam yu'minoo fasbiroo hattaa yahkumual laahu bainanaa; wa Huwa khairul haakimeen
ayahs.en: And if there should be a group among you who has believed in that with which I have been sent and a group that has not believed, then be patient until Allah judges between us. And He is the best of judges."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ الۡمَلَاُ الَّذِيۡنَ اسۡتَكۡبَرُوۡا مِنۡ قَوۡمِهٖ لَنُخۡرِجَنَّكَ يٰشُعَيۡبُ وَالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا مَعَكَ مِنۡ قَرۡيَتِنَا٘ اَوۡ لَتَعُوۡدُنَّ فِيۡ مِلَّتِنَاؕ قَالَ اَوَلَوۡ كُنَّا كٰرِهِيۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaalal mala ul lazeenas takbaroo min qawmihee lanukhrijannaka yaa Shu'aibu wallazeena aamanoo ma'aka min qaryatinaaa aw lata'oo dunna fee millatinaa; qaala awa law kunnaa kaariheen
ayahs.en: Said the eminent ones who were arrogant among his people, "We will surely evict you, O Shu'ayb, and those who have believed with you from our city, or you must return to our religion." He said, "Even if we were unwilling?"

ayahs.ar: قَدِ افۡتَرَيۡنَا عَلَي اللّٰهِ كَذِبًا اِنۡ عُدۡنَا فِيۡ مِلَّتِكُمۡ بَعۡدَ اِذۡ نَجّٰىنَا اللّٰهُ مِنۡهَاؕ وَمَا يَكُوۡنُ لَنَا٘ اَنۡ نَّعُوۡدَ فِيۡهَا٘ اِلَّا٘ اَنۡ يَّشَآءَ اللّٰهُ رَبُّنَاؕ وَسِعَ رَبُّنَا كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ عِلۡمًاؕ عَلَي اللّٰهِ تَوَكَّلۡنَاؕ رَبَّنَا افۡتَحۡ بَيۡنَنَا وَبَيۡنَ قَوۡمِنَا بِالۡحَقِّ وَاَنۡتَ خَيۡرُ الۡفٰتِحِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qadif tarainaa 'alal laahi kaziban in 'udnaa fee millatikum ba'da iz najjaanal laahu minhaa; wa maa yakoonu lanaaa an na'ooda feehaaa illaaa ai yashaaa'al laahu Rabbunaa; wasi'a Rabbunaa kulla shai'in 'ilmaa; 'alal laahi tawakkalnaa; Rabbanaf tah bainanaa wa baina qawminaa bilhaqqi wa Anta khairul faatiheen
ayahs.en: We would have invented against Allah a lie if we returned to your religion after Allah had saved us from it. And it is not for us to return to it except that Allah, our Lord, should will. Our Lord has encompassed all things in knowledge. Upon Allah we have relied. Our Lord, decide between us and our people in truth, and You are the best of those who give decision."

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ الۡمَلَاُ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا مِنۡ قَوۡمِهٖ لَئِنِ اتَّبَعۡتُمۡ شُعَيۡبًا اِنَّكُمۡ اِذًا لَّخٰسِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaalal mala ul lazeena kafaroo min qawmihee la'init taba'tum Shu'aiban innakum izal lakhaasiroon
ayahs.en: Said the eminent ones who disbelieved among his people, "If you should follow Shu'ayb, indeed, you would then be losers."

ayahs.ar: فَاَخَذَتۡهُمُ الرَّجۡفَةُ فَاَصۡبَحُوۡا فِيۡ دَارِهِمۡ جٰثِمِيۡنَۚۛۖۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Fa akhazat humur rajfatu fa asbahoo fee daarihim jaasimeen
ayahs.en: So the earthquake seized them, and they became within their home [corpses] fallen prone.

ayahs.ar: الَّذِيۡنَ كَذَّبُوۡا شُعَيۡبًا كَاَنۡ لَّمۡ يَغۡنَوۡا فِيۡهَاۚۛ اَلَّذِيۡنَ كَذَّبُوۡا شُعَيۡبًا كَانُوۡا هُمُ الۡخٰسِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Allazeena kazzaboo Shu'aiban ka al alm yaghnaw feehaa; allazeena kazzaboo Shu'aiban kaanoo humul khaasireen
ayahs.en: Those who denied Shu'ayb - it was as though they had never resided there. Those who denied Shu'ayb - it was they who were the losers.

ayahs.ar: فَتَوَلّٰي عَنۡهُمۡ وَقَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ لَقَدۡ اَبۡلَغۡتُكُمۡ رِسٰلٰتِ رَبِّيۡ وَنَصَحۡتُ لَكُمۡۚ فَكَيۡفَ اٰسٰي عَلٰي قَوۡمٍ كٰفِرِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Fatawalla 'anhum wa qaala yaa qawmi laqad ablaghtukum Risaalaati Rabbee wa nasahtu lakum fakaifa aasaa'alaa qawmin kaafireen
ayahs.en: And he turned away from them and said, "O my people, I had certainly conveyed to you the messages of my Lord and advised you, so how could I grieve for a disbelieving people?"

ayahs.ar: وَمَا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنَا فِيۡ قَرۡيَةٍ مِّنۡ نَّبِيٍّ اِلَّا٘ اَخَذۡنَا٘ اَهۡلَهَا بِالۡبَاۡسَآءِ وَالضَّرَّآءِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَضَّرَّعُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa maaa arsalnaa fee qaryatim min Nabiyyin illaaa akhaznaaa ahlahaa bil baasaaa'i waddarraaa'i la'allahum yaddarra'oon
ayahs.en: And We sent to no city a prophet [who was denied] except that We seized its people with poverty and hardship that they might humble themselves [to Allah].

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ بَدَّلۡنَا مَكَانَ السَّيِّئَةِ الۡحَسَنَةَ حَتّٰي عَفَوۡا وَّقَالُوۡا قَدۡ مَسَّ اٰبَآءَنَا الضَّرَّآءُ وَالسَّرَّآءُ فَاَخَذۡنٰهُمۡ بَغۡتَةً وَّهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Summa baddalnaa makaa nas saiyi'atil hasanata hattaa 'afaw wa qaaloo qad massa aabaa'anad darraaa'u wassarraaa'u fa akhaznaahum baghtatanw wa hum laa yash'uroon
ayahs.en: Then We exchanged in place of the bad [condition], good, until they increased [and prospered] and said, "Our fathers [also] were touched with hardship and ease." So We seized them suddenly while they did not perceive.

ayahs.ar: وَلَوۡ اَنَّ اَهۡلَ الۡقُرٰ٘ي اٰمَنُوۡا وَاتَّقَوۡا لَفَتَحۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ بَرَكٰتٍ مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَلٰكِنۡ كَذَّبُوۡا فَاَخَذۡنٰهُمۡ بِمَا كَانُوۡا يَكۡسِبُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa law anna ahlal quraaa aamanoo wattaqaw lafatahnaa 'alaihim barakaatim minas samaaa'i wal ardi wa laakin kazzaboo fa akhaznaahum bimaa kaanoo yaksiboon
ayahs.en: And if only the people of the cities had believed and feared Allah, We would have opened upon them blessings from the heaven and the earth; but they denied [the messengers], so We seized them for what they were earning."

ayahs.ar: اَفَاَمِنَ اَهۡلُ الۡقُرٰ٘ي اَنۡ يَّاۡتِيَهُمۡ بَاۡسُنَا بَيَاتًا وَّهُمۡ نَآئِمُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Afa amina ahlul quraaa ai yaatiyahum baasunaa bayaatanw wa hum naaa'imoon
ayahs.en: Then, did the people of the cities feel secure from Our punishment coming to them at night while they were asleep?

ayahs.ar: اَوَاَمِنَ اَهۡلُ الۡقُرٰ٘ي اَنۡ يَّاۡتِيَهُمۡ بَاۡسُنَا ضُحًي وَّهُمۡ يَلۡعَبُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Awa amina ahlul quraaa ai yaatiyahum baasunaa duhanw wa hum yal'aboon
ayahs.en: Or did the people of the cities feel secure from Our punishment coming to them in the morning while they were at play?

ayahs.ar: اَفَاَمِنُوۡا مَكۡرَ اللّٰهِۚ فَلَا يَاۡمَنُ مَكۡرَ اللّٰهِ اِلَّا الۡقَوۡمُ الۡخٰسِرُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Afa aminoo makral laah; falaa yaamanu makral laahi illal qawmul khaasiroon
ayahs.en: Then did they feel secure from the plan of Allah? But no one feels secure from the plan of Allah except the losing people.

ayahs.ar: اَوَلَمۡ يَهۡدِ لِلَّذِيۡنَ يَرِثُوۡنَ الۡاَرۡضَ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ اَهۡلِهَا٘ اَنۡ لَّوۡ نَشَآءُ اَصَبۡنٰهُمۡ بِذُنُوۡبِهِمۡۚ وَنَطۡبَعُ عَلٰي قُلُوۡبِهِمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يَسۡمَعُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Awa lam yahdi lillazeena yarisoonal arda mim ba'di ahlihaaa al law nashaaa'u asabnaahum bizunoobihim; wa natba'u 'alaa quloobihim fahum laa yasma'oon
ayahs.en: Has it not become clear to those who inherited the earth after its [previous] people that if We willed, We could afflict them for their sins? But We seal over their hearts so they do not hear.

ayahs.ar: تِلۡكَ الۡقُرٰي نَقُصُّ عَلَيۡكَ مِنۡ اَنۭۡ بَآئِهَاۚ وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَتۡهُمۡ رُسُلُهُمۡ بِالۡبَيِّنٰتِۚ فَمَا كَانُوۡا لِيُؤۡمِنُوۡا بِمَا كَذَّبُوۡا مِنۡ قَبۡلُؕ كَذٰلِكَ يَطۡبَعُ اللّٰهُ عَلٰي قُلُوۡبِ الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Tilkal quraa naqussu 'alaika min ambaaa'ihaa; wa laqad jaaa'at hum Rusuluhum bilbaiyinaati famaa kaanoo liyu'minoo bimaa kazzaboo min qabl; kazaalika yatba'ul laahu 'alaa quloobil kaafireen
ayahs.en: Those cities - We relate to you, [O Muhammad], some of their news. And certainly did their messengers come to them with clear proofs, but they were not to believe in that which they had denied before. Thus does Allah seal over the hearts of the disbelievers.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا وَجَدۡنَا لِاَكۡثَرِهِمۡ مِّنۡ عَهۡدٍۚ وَاِنۡ وَّجَدۡنَا٘ اَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَفٰسِقِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa maa wajadnaa li aksarihim min 'ahd; wa inw wajadnaaa aksarahum lafaasiqeen
ayahs.en: And We did not find for most of them any covenant; but indeed, We found most of them defiantly disobedient.

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ بَعَثۡنَا مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِهِمۡ مُّوۡسٰي بِاٰيٰتِنَا٘ اِلٰي فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَمَلَا۠ئِهٖ فَظَلَمُوۡا بِهَاۚ فَانۡظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الۡمُفۡسِدِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Summa ba'asnaa mim ba'dihim Moosaa bi Aayaatinaaa ilaa Fir'awana wa mala'ihee fazalamoo bihaa fanzur kaifa kaana 'aaqibatul mufsideen
ayahs.en: Then We sent after them Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his establishment, but they were unjust toward them. So see how was the end of the corrupters.

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ مُوۡسٰي يٰفِرۡعَوۡنُ اِنِّيۡ رَسُوۡلٌ مِّنۡ رَّبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa qaala Moosaa yaa Fir'awnu inee Rasoolum mir Rabbil 'aalameen
ayahs.en: And Moses said, "O Pharaoh, I am a messenger from the Lord of the worlds

ayahs.ar: حَقِيۡقٌ عَلٰ٘ي اَنۡ لَّا٘ اَقُوۡلَ عَلَي اللّٰهِ اِلَّا الۡحَقَّؕ قَدۡ جِئۡتُكُمۡ بِبَيِّنَةٍ مِّنۡ رَّبِّكُمۡ فَاَرۡسِلۡ مَعِيَ بَنِيۡ٘ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Haqeequn 'alaaa al laaa aqoola 'alal laahi illal haqq; qad ji'tukum bibaiyinatim mir Rabbikum fa arsil ma'iya Baneee Israaa'eel
ayahs.en: [Who is] obligated not to say about Allah except the truth. I have come to you with clear evidence from your Lord, so send with me the Children of Israel."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ اِنۡ كُنۡتَ جِئۡتَ بِاٰيَةٍ فَاۡتِ بِهَا٘ اِنۡ كُنۡتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala in kunta ji'ta bi Aayatin faati bihaaa in kunta minas saadiqeen
ayahs.en: [Pharaoh] said, "If you have come with a sign, then bring it forth, if you should be of the truthful."

ayahs.ar: فَاَلۡقٰي عَصَاهُ فَاِذَا هِيَ ثُعۡبَانٌ مُّبِيۡنٌۚۖ‏
ayahs.tl: Qa alqaa 'asaahu fa izaa hiya su'baanum mubeen
ayahs.en: So Moses threw his staff, and suddenly it was a serpent, manifest.

ayahs.ar: وَّنَزَعَ يَدَهٗ فَاِذَا هِيَ بَيۡضَآءُ لِلنّٰظِرِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa naza'a yadahoo fa izaa hiya baidaaa'u linnaazireen
ayahs.en: And he drew out his hand; thereupon it was white [with radiance] for the observers.

ayahs.ar: قَالَ الۡمَلَاُ مِنۡ قَوۡمِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ اِنَّ هٰذَا لَسٰحِرٌ عَلِيۡمٌۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaalal mala-u min qawmi Fir'awna inna haazaa lasaa hirun 'aleem
ayahs.en: Said the eminent among the people of Pharaoh, "Indeed, this is a learned magician

ayahs.ar: يُّرِيۡدُ اَنۡ يُّخۡرِجَكُمۡ مِّنۡ اَرۡضِكُمۡۚ فَمَاذَا تَاۡمُرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Yureedu ai yukhrijakum min ardikum famaazaa taamuroon
ayahs.en: Who wants to expel you from your land [through magic], so what do you instruct?"

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡ٘ا اَرۡجِهۡ وَاَخَاهُ وَاَرۡسِلۡ فِي الۡمَدَآئِنِ حٰشِرِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaalooo arjih wa akhaahu wa arsil filmadaaa'ini haashireen
ayahs.en: They said, "Postpone [the matter of] him and his brother and send among the cities gatherers

ayahs.ar: يَاۡتُوۡكَ بِكُلِّ سٰحِرٍ عَلِيۡمٍ
ayahs.tl: Yaatooka bikulli saahirin 'aleem
ayahs.en: Who will bring you every learned magician."

ayahs.ar: وَجَآءَ السَّحَرَةُ فِرۡعَوۡنَ قَالُوۡ٘ا اِنَّ لَنَا لَاَجۡرًا اِنۡ كُنَّا نَحۡنُ الۡغٰلِبِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa jaaa'as saharatu Fir'awna qaaloo inna lanaa la ajjran in kunnaa nahnul ghaalibeen
ayahs.en: And the magicians came to Pharaoh. They said, "Indeed for us is a reward if we are the predominant."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ نَعَمۡ وَاِنَّكُمۡ لَمِنَ الۡمُقَرَّبِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala na'am wa innakum laminal muqarrabeen
ayahs.en: He said, "Yes, and, [moreover], you will be among those made near [to me]."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا يٰمُوۡسٰ٘ي اِمَّا٘ اَنۡ تُلۡقِيَ وَاِمَّا٘ اَنۡ نَّكُوۡنَ نَحۡنُ الۡمُلۡقِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo yaa Moosaaa immaaa an tulqiya wa immaaa an nakoona nahnul mulqeen
ayahs.en: They said, "O Moses, either you throw [your staff], or we will be the ones to throw [first]."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ اَلۡقُوۡاۚ فَلَمَّا٘ اَلۡقَوۡا سَحَرُوۡ٘ا اَعۡيُنَ النَّاسِ وَاسۡتَرۡهَبُوۡهُمۡ وَجَآءُوۡ بِسِحۡرٍ عَظِيۡمٍ
ayahs.tl: Qaala alqoo falam maaa alqaw saharooo a'yunannaasi wastarhaboohum wa jaaa'oo bisihrin 'azeem
ayahs.en: He said, "Throw," and when they threw, they bewitched the eyes of the people and struck terror into them, and they presented a great [feat of] magic.

ayahs.ar: وَاَوۡحَيۡنَا٘ اِلٰي مُوۡسٰ٘ي اَنۡ اَلۡقِ عَصَاكَۚ فَاِذَا هِيَ تَلۡقَفُ مَا يَاۡفِكُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa awhainaaa ilaa Moosaaa an alqi 'asaaka fa izaa hiya talqafu maa yaafikoon
ayahs.en: And We inspired to Moses, "Throw your staff," and at once it devoured what they were falsifying.

ayahs.ar: فَوَقَعَ الۡحَقُّ وَبَطَلَ مَا كَانُوۡا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Fawaqa'al haqqu wa batala maa kaanoo ya'maloon
ayahs.en: So the truth was established, and abolished was what they were doing.

ayahs.ar: فَغُلِبُوۡا هُنَالِكَ وَانۡقَلَبُوۡا صٰغِرِيۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Faghuliboo hunaalika wanqalaboo saaghireen
ayahs.en: And Pharaoh and his people were overcome right there and became debased.

ayahs.ar: وَاُلۡقِيَ السَّحَرَةُ سٰجِدِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa ulqiyas saharatu saajideen
ayahs.en: And the magicians fell down in prostration [to Allah].

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡ٘ا اٰمَنَّا بِرَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo aamannaa bi Rabbil 'aalameen
ayahs.en: They said, "We have believed in the Lord of the worlds,

ayahs.ar: رَبِّ مُوۡسٰي وَهٰرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Rabbi Moosaa wa Haaroon
ayahs.en: The Lord of Moses and Aaron."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ اٰمَنۡتُمۡ بِهٖ قَبۡلَ اَنۡ اٰذَنَ لَكُمۡۚ اِنَّ هٰذَا لَمَكۡرٌ مَّكَرۡتُمُوۡهُ فِي الۡمَدِيۡنَةِ لِتُخۡرِجُوۡا مِنۡهَا٘ اَهۡلَهَاۚ فَسَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala Fir'awnu aamantum bihee qabla an aazana lakum; inna haaza lamakrum makartumoohu filmadeenati litukhrijoo minhaaa ahlahaa fasawfa ta'almoon
ayahs.en: Said Pharaoh, "You believed in him before I gave you permission. Indeed, this is a conspiracy which you conspired in the city to expel therefrom its people. But you are going to know.

ayahs.ar: لَاُقَطِّعَنَّ اَيۡدِيَكُمۡ وَاَرۡجُلَكُمۡ مِّنۡ خِلَافٍ ثُمَّ لَاُصَلِّبَنَّكُمۡ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: La uqatti'anna aidiyakum wa arjulakum min khilaafin summa la usallibannakum ajma'een
ayahs.en: I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides; then I will surely crucify you all."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡ٘ا اِنَّا٘ اِلٰي رَبِّنَا مُنۡقَلِبُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo innaaa ilaa Rabbinaa munqaliboon
ayahs.en: They said, "Indeed, to our Lord we will return.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا تَنۡقِمُ مِنَّا٘ اِلَّا٘ اَنۡ اٰمَنَّا بِاٰيٰتِ رَبِّنَا لَمَّا جَآءَتۡنَاؕ رَبَّنَا٘ اَفۡرِغۡ عَلَيۡنَا صَبۡرًا وَّتَوَفَّنَا مُسۡلِمِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa maa tanqimu minnaaa illaaa an aamannaa bi Aayaati Rabbinaa lammaa jaaa'atnaa; Rabbanaaa afrigh 'alainaa sabranw wa tawaffanaa muslimeen
ayahs.en: And you do not resent us except because we believed in the signs of our Lord when they came to us. Our Lord, pour upon us patience and let us die as Muslims [in submission to You]."

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ الۡمَلَاُ مِنۡ قَوۡمِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ اَتَذَرُ مُوۡسٰي وَقَوۡمَهٗ لِيُفۡسِدُوۡا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَيَذَرَكَ وَاٰلِهَتَكَؕ قَالَ سَنُقَتِّلُ اَبۡنَآءَهُمۡ وَنَسۡتَحۡيٖ نِسَآءَهُمۡۚ وَاِنَّا فَوۡقَهُمۡ قٰهِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaalal mala-u min qawmi Fir'awna atazaru Moosaa wa qawmahoo liyufsidoo fil ardi wa yazaraka wa aalihatak; qaala sanuqattilu abnaaa 'ahum wa nastahyee nisaaa'ahum wa innaa fawqahum qaahiroon
ayahs.en: And the eminent among the people of Pharaoh said," Will you leave Moses and his people to cause corruption in the land and abandon you and your gods?" [Pharaoh] said, "We will kill their sons and keep their women alive; and indeed, we are subjugators over them."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ مُوۡسٰي لِقَوۡمِهِ اسۡتَعِيۡنُوۡا بِاللّٰهِ وَاصۡبِرُوۡاۚ اِنَّ الۡاَرۡضَ لِلّٰهِࣞۙ يُوۡرِثُهَا مَنۡ يَّشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهٖؕ وَالۡعَاقِبَةُ لِلۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala Moosaa liqawmihis ta'eenoo billaahi wasbiroo innal arda lillaahi yoorisuhaa mai yashaaa'u min 'ibaadihee wal 'aaqibatu lilmuttaqeen
ayahs.en: Said Moses to his people, "Seek help through Allah and be patient. Indeed, the earth belongs to Allah. He causes to inherit it whom He wills of His servants. And the [best] outcome is for the righteous."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡ٘ا اُوۡذِيۡنَا مِنۡ قَبۡلِ اَنۡ تَاۡتِيَنَا وَمِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ مَا جِئۡتَنَاؕ قَالَ عَسٰي رَبُّكُمۡ اَنۡ يُّهۡلِكَ عَدُوَّكُمۡ وَيَسۡتَخۡلِفَكُمۡ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ فَيَنۡظُرَ كَيۡفَ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo oozeenaa min qabli an taatiyanaa wa mim ba'di maa ji'tanaa; qaala 'asaa Rabbukum ai yuhlika 'aduwwakum wa yastakhli fakum fil ardi fayanzura kaifa ta'maloon
ayahs.en: They said, "We have been harmed before you came to us and after you have come to us." He said, "Perhaps your Lord will destroy your enemy and grant you succession in the land and see how you will do."

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اَخَذۡنَا٘ اٰلَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ بِالسِّنِيۡنَ وَنَقۡصٍ مِّنَ الثَّمَرٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَذَّكَّرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad akhaznaaa Aala Fir'awna bis sineena wa naqsim minas samaraati la'allahum yazzakkaroon
ayahs.en: And We certainly seized the people of Pharaoh with years of famine and a deficiency in fruits that perhaps they would be reminded.

ayahs.ar: فَاِذَا جَآءَتۡهُمُ الۡحَسَنَةُ قَالُوۡا لَنَا هٰذِهٖۚ وَاِنۡ تُصِبۡهُمۡ سَيِّئَةٌ يَّطَّيَّرُوۡا بِمُوۡسٰي وَمَنۡ مَّعَهٗؕ اَلَا٘ اِنَّمَا طٰٓئِرُهُمۡ عِنۡدَ اللّٰهِ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fa izaa jaaa'at humul hasanatu qaaloo lanaa haazihee wa in tusibhum saiyi'atuny yattaiyaroo bi Moosaa wa mam ma'ah; alaaa innamaa taaa'iruhum 'indal laahi wa laakinna aksarahum laa ya'lamoon
ayahs.en: But when good came to them, they said, "This is ours [by right]." And if a bad [condition] struck them, they saw an evil omen in Moses and those with him. Unquestionably, their fortune is with Allah, but most of them do not know.

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُوۡا مَهۡمَا تَاۡتِنَا بِهٖ مِنۡ اٰيَةٍ لِّتَسۡحَرَنَا بِهَاۙ فَمَا نَحۡنُ لَكَ بِمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaaloo mahmaa taatinaa bihee min Aayatil litasharanaa bihaa famaa nahnu laka bimu'mineen
ayahs.en: And they said, "No matter what sign you bring us with which to bewitch us, we will not be believers in you."

ayahs.ar: فَاَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمُ الطُّوۡفَانَ وَالۡجَرَادَ وَالۡقُمَّلَ وَالضَّفَادِعَ وَالدَّمَ اٰيٰتٍ مُّفَصَّلٰتٍࣞ فَاسۡتَكۡبَرُوۡا وَكَانُوۡا قَوۡمًا مُّجۡرِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fa arsalnaa 'alaihimut toofaana waljaraada walqum mala waddafaadi'a waddama Aayaatim mufassalaatin fastakbaroo wa kaanoo qawmam mujrimeen
ayahs.en: So We sent upon them the flood and locusts and lice and frogs and blood as distinct signs, but they were arrogant and were a criminal people.

ayahs.ar: وَلَمَّا وَقَعَ عَلَيۡهِمُ الرِّجۡزُ قَالُوۡا يٰمُوۡسَي ادۡعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِنۡدَكَۚ لَئِنۡ كَشَفۡتَ عَنَّا الرِّجۡزَ لَنُؤۡمِنَنَّ لَكَ وَلَنُرۡسِلَنَّ مَعَكَ بَنِيۡ٘ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa lammaa waqa'a 'alaihimur rijzu qaaloo ya Moosad-u lanaa rabbaka bimaa 'ahida 'indaka la'in kashafta 'annar rijza lanu 'minanna laka wa lanursilanna ma'aka Banee Israaa'eel
ayahs.en: And when the punishment descended upon them, they said, "O Moses, invoke for us your Lord by what He has promised you. If you [can] remove the punishment from us, we will surely believe you, and we will send with you the Children of Israel."

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا كَشَفۡنَا عَنۡهُمُ الرِّجۡزَ اِلٰ٘ي اَجَلٍ هُمۡ بٰلِغُوۡهُ اِذَا هُمۡ يَنۡكُثُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Falammaa kashafnaa 'anhumur rijza ilaaa ajalin hum baalighoohu izaa hum yankusoon
ayahs.en: But when We removed the punishment from them until a term which they were to reach, then at once they broke their word.

ayahs.ar: فَانۡتَقَمۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡ فَاَغۡرَقۡنٰهُمۡ فِي الۡيَمِّ بِاَنَّهُمۡ كَذَّبُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِنَا وَكَانُوۡا عَنۡهَا غٰفِلِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fantaqamnaa minhum fa aghraqnaahum kazzaboo bi Aayaatinaa wa kaanoo 'anhaa ghaafileen
ayahs.en: So We took retribution from them, and We drowned them in the sea because they denied Our signs and were heedless of them.

ayahs.ar: وَاَوۡرَثۡنَا الۡقَوۡمَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَانُوۡا يُسۡتَضۡعَفُوۡنَ مَشَارِقَ الۡاَرۡضِ وَمَغَارِبَهَا الَّتِيۡ بٰرَكۡنَا فِيۡهَاؕ وَتَمَّتۡ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ الۡحُسۡنٰي عَلٰي بَنِيۡ٘ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَ ࣢ۙ بِمَا صَبَرُوۡاؕ وَدَمَّرۡنَا مَا كَانَ يَصۡنَعُ فِرۡعَوۡنُ وَقَوۡمُهٗ وَمَا كَانُوۡا يَعۡرِشُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa awrasnal qawmal lazeena kaanoo yustad'afoona mashaariqal ardi wa maghaari bahal latee baaraknaa feehaa wa tammat kalimatu Rabbikal husnaa 'alaa Baneee Israaa'eela bimaa sabaroo wa dammarnaa maa kaana yasna'u Fir'awnu wa qawmuhoo wa maa kaanoo ya'rishoon
ayahs.en: And We caused the people who had been oppressed to inherit the eastern regions of the land and the western ones, which We had blessed. And the good word of your Lord was fulfilled for the Children of Israel because of what they had patiently endured. And We destroyed [all] that Pharaoh and his people were producing and what they had been building.

ayahs.ar: وَجٰوَزۡنَا بِبَنِيۡ٘ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَ الۡبَحۡرَ فَاَتَوۡا عَلٰي قَوۡمٍ يَّعۡكُفُوۡنَ عَلٰ٘ي اَصۡنَامٍ لَّهُمۡۚ قَالُوۡا يٰمُوۡسَي اجۡعَلۡ لَّنَا٘ اِلٰهًا كَمَا لَهُمۡ اٰلِهَةٌؕ قَالَ اِنَّكُمۡ قَوۡمٌ تَجۡهَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa jaawaznaa bi Banneee Israaa'eelal bahra fa ataw 'alaa qawminy ya'kufoona 'alaaa asnaamil lahum; qaaloo yaa Moosaj'al lanaa ilaahan kamaa lahum aalihah; qaala innakum qawmun tajhaloon
ayahs.en: And We took the Children of Israel across the sea; then they came upon a people intent in devotion to [some] idols of theirs. They said, "O Moses, make for us a god just as they have gods." He said, "Indeed, you are a people behaving ignorantly.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ مُتَبَّرٌ مَّا هُمۡ فِيۡهِ وَبٰطِلٌ مَّا كَانُوۡا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Innaa haaa'ulaaa'i mutabbarum maa hum feehi wa baatilum maa kaanoo ya'maloon
ayahs.en: Indeed, those [worshippers] - destroyed is that in which they are [engaged], and worthless is whatever they were doing."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ اَغَيۡرَ اللّٰهِ اَبۡغِيۡكُمۡ اِلٰهًا وَّهُوَ فَضَّلَكُمۡ عَلَي الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala a-ghairal laahi abgheekum ilaahanw wa Huwa faddalakum 'alal 'aalameen
ayahs.en: He said, "Is it other than Allah I should desire for you as a god while He has preferred you over the worlds?"

ayahs.ar: وَاِذۡ اَنۡجَيۡنٰكُمۡ مِّنۡ اٰلِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ يَسُوۡمُوۡنَكُمۡ سُوۡٓءَ الۡعَذَابِۚ يُقَتِّلُوۡنَ اَبۡنَآءَكُمۡ وَيَسۡتَحۡيُوۡنَ نِسَآءَكُمۡؕ وَفِيۡ ذٰلِكُمۡ بَلَآءٌ مِّنۡ رَّبِّكُمۡ عَظِيۡمٌࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa iz anjainaakum min Aali Fir'awna yasoomoo nakum sooo'al 'azaab, yuqattiloona abnaaa'akum wa yastahyoona nisaaa'akum; wa fee zaalikum balaaa'um mir Rabbikum 'azeem
ayahs.en: And [recall, O Children of Israel], when We saved you from the people of Pharaoh, [who were] afflicting you with the worst torment - killing your sons and keeping your women alive. And in that was a great trial from your Lord.

ayahs.ar: وَوٰعَدۡنَا مُوۡسٰي ثَلٰثِيۡنَ لَيۡلَةً وَّاَتۡمَمۡنٰهَا بِعَشۡرٍ فَتَمَّ مِيۡقَاتُ رَبِّهٖ٘ اَرۡبَعِيۡنَ لَيۡلَةًۚ وَقَالَ مُوۡسٰي لِاَخِيۡهِ هٰرُوۡنَ اخۡلُفۡنِيۡ فِيۡ قَوۡمِيۡ وَاَصۡلِحۡ وَلَا تَتَّبِعۡ سَبِيۡلَ الۡمُفۡسِدِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa waa'adnaa Moosaa salaaseena lailatanw wa at mamnaahaa bi'ashrim fatamma meeqaatu Rabbihee arba'eena lailah; wa qaala Moosaa liakheehi Haaroonakh lufnee fee qawmee wa aslih wa laa tattabi' sabeelal mufsideen
ayahs.en: And We made an appointment with Moses for thirty nights and perfected them by [the addition of] ten; so the term of his Lord was completed as forty nights. And Moses said to his brother Aaron, "Take my place among my people, do right [by them], and do not follow the way of the corrupters."

ayahs.ar: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ مُوۡسٰي لِمِيۡقَاتِنَا وَكَلَّمَهٗ رَبُّهٗۙ قَالَ رَبِّ اَرِنِيۡ٘ اَنۡظُرۡ اِلَيۡكَؕ قَالَ لَنۡ تَرٰىنِيۡ وَلٰكِنِ انۡظُرۡ اِلَي الۡجَبَلِ فَاِنِ اسۡتَقَرَّ مَكَانَهٗ فَسَوۡفَ تَرٰىنِيۡۚ فَلَمَّا تَجَلّٰي رَبُّهٗ لِلۡجَبَلِ جَعَلَهٗ دَكًّا وَّخَرَّ مُوۡسٰي صَعِقًاۚ فَلَمَّا٘ اَفَاقَ قَالَ سُبۡحٰنَكَ تُبۡتُ اِلَيۡكَ وَاَنَا اَوَّلُ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa lammaa jaaa'a Moosa limeeqaatinaa wa kallamahoo Rabbuhoo qaala Rabbi arineee anzur ilaik; qaala lan taraanee wa laakininzur ilal jabali fa inistaqarra makaanahoo faswfa taraanee; falammaa tajallaa Rabbuhoo liljabali ja'alahoo dakkanw wa kharra Moosaa sa'iqaa; falammaaa afaaqa qaala Subhaanaka tubtu ilaika wa ana awwalul mu'mineen
ayahs.en: And when Moses arrived at Our appointed time and his Lord spoke to him, he said, "My Lord, show me [Yourself] that I may look at You." [Allah] said, "You will not see Me, but look at the mountain; if it should remain in place, then you will see Me." But when his Lord appeared to the mountain, He rendered it level, and Moses fell unconscious. And when he awoke, he said, "Exalted are You! I have repented to You, and I am the first of the believers."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ يٰمُوۡسٰ٘ي اِنِّي اصۡطَفَيۡتُكَ عَلَي النَّاسِ بِرِسٰلٰتِيۡ وَبِكَلَامِيۡؗۖ فَخُذۡ مَا٘ اٰتَيۡتُكَ وَكُنۡ مِّنَ الشّٰكِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala yaa Moosaaa innis tafaituka 'alan naasi bi Risaalaatee wa bi kalaamee fakhuz maaa aataituka wa kum minash shaakireen
ayahs.en: [Allah] said, "O Moses, I have chosen you over the people with My messages and My words [to you]. So take what I have given you and be among the grateful."

ayahs.ar: وَكَتَبۡنَا لَهٗ فِي الۡاَلۡوَاحِ مِنۡ كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ مَّوۡعِظَةً وَّتَفۡصِيۡلًا لِّكُلِّ شَيۡءٍۚ فَخُذۡهَا بِقُوَّةٍ وَّاۡمُرۡ قَوۡمَكَ يَاۡخُذُوۡا بِاَحۡسَنِهَاؕ سَاُورِيۡكُمۡ دَارَ الۡفٰسِقِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa katabnaa lahoo fil alwaahi minkulli shai'immaw 'izaanw wa tafseelal likulli shai'in fakhuzhaa biquwwatinw waamur qawmaka yaakhuzoo bi ahsanihaa; wa ooreekum daaral faasiqeen
ayahs.en: And We wrote for him on the tablets [something] of all things - instruction and explanation for all things, [saying], "Take them with determination and order your people to take the best of it. I will show you the home of the defiantly disobedient."

ayahs.ar: سَاَصۡرِفُ عَنۡ اٰيٰتِيَ الَّذِيۡنَ يَتَكَبَّرُوۡنَ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ بِغَيۡرِ الۡحَقِّؕ وَاِنۡ يَّرَوۡا كُلَّ اٰيَةٍ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُوۡا بِهَاۚ وَاِنۡ يَّرَوۡا سَبِيۡلَ الرُّشۡدِ لَا يَتَّخِذُوۡهُ سَبِيۡلًاۚ وَاِنۡ يَّرَوۡا سَبِيۡلَ الۡغَيِّ يَتَّخِذُوۡهُ سَبِيۡلًاؕ ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمۡ كَذَّبُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِنَا وَكَانُوۡا عَنۡهَا غٰفِلِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Sa asrifu 'an Aayaatiyal lazeena yatakabbaroona fil ardi bighairil haqq; wa iny-yaraw kulla Aayatil laa yu'minoo bihaa wa iny-yaraw sabeelar rushdi laa yattakhizoohu sabeelanw wa iny-yaraw sabeelal ghaiyi yatta khizoohu sabeelaa; zaalika bi annahum kazzaboo bi Aayaatinaa wa kaanoo 'anhaa ghaafileen
ayahs.en: I will turn away from My signs those who are arrogant upon the earth without right; and if they should see every sign, they will not believe in it. And if they see the way of consciousness, they will not adopt it as a way; but if they see the way of error, they will adopt it as a way. That is because they have denied Our signs and they were heedless of them.

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ كَذَّبُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِنَا وَلِقَآءِ الۡاٰخِرَةِ حَبِطَتۡ اَعۡمَالُهُمۡؕ هَلۡ يُجۡزَوۡنَ اِلَّا مَا كَانُوۡا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wallazeena kazzaboo bi Aayaatinaa wa liqaaa'il Aakhirati habitat 'amaaluhum; hal yujzawna illaa maa kaanoo ya'maloon
ayahs.en: Those who denied Our signs and the meeting of the Hereafter - their deeds have become worthless. Are they recompensed except for what they used to do?

ayahs.ar: وَاتَّخَذَ قَوۡمُ مُوۡسٰي مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِهٖ مِنۡ حُلِيِّهِمۡ عِجۡلًا جَسَدًا لَّهٗ خُوَارٌؕ اَلَمۡ يَرَوۡا اَنَّهٗ لَا يُكَلِّمُهُمۡ وَلَا يَهۡدِيۡهِمۡ سَبِيۡلًاۘ اِتَّخَذُوۡهُ وَكَانُوۡا ظٰلِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wattakhaza qawmu Moosaa mim ba'dihee min huliyyihim 'ijlan jasadal lahoo khuwaar; alam yaraw annahoo laa yukallimuhum wa laa yahdeehim sabeelaa; ittakha zoohu wa kaanoo zaalimeen
ayahs.en: And the people of Moses made, after [his departure], from their ornaments a calf - an image having a lowing sound. Did they not see that it could neither speak to them nor guide them to a way? They took it [for worship], and they were wrongdoers.

ayahs.ar: وَلَمَّا سُقِطَ فِيۡ٘ اَيۡدِيۡهِمۡ وَرَاَوۡا اَنَّهُمۡ قَدۡ ضَلُّوۡاۙ قَالُوۡا لَئِنۡ لَّمۡ يَرۡحَمۡنَا رَبُّنَا وَيَغۡفِرۡ لَنَا لَنَكُوۡنَنَّ مِنَ الۡخٰسِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa lammaa suqita feee aideehim wa ra aw annahum qad dalloo qaaloo la'il lam yarhamnaa Rabbunaa wa yaghfir lanaa lanakoonanna minal khaasireen
ayahs.en: And when regret overcame them and they saw that they had gone astray, they said, "If our Lord does not have mercy upon us and forgive us, we will surely be among the losers."

ayahs.ar: وَلَمَّا رَجَعَ مُوۡسٰ٘ي اِلٰي قَوۡمِهٖ غَضۡبَانَ اَسِفًاۙ قَالَ بِئۡسَمَا خَلَفۡتُمُوۡنِيۡ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِيۡۚ اَعَجِلۡتُمۡ اَمۡرَ رَبِّكُمۡۚ وَاَلۡقَي الۡاَلۡوَاحَ وَاَخَذَ بِرَاۡسِ اَخِيۡهِ يَجُرُّهٗ٘ اِلَيۡهِؕ قَالَ ابۡنَ اُمَّ اِنَّ الۡقَوۡمَ اسۡتَضۡعَفُوۡنِيۡ وَكَادُوۡا يَقۡتُلُوۡنَنِيۡؗۖ فَلَا تُشۡمِتۡ بِيَ الۡاَعۡدَآءَ وَلَا تَجۡعَلۡنِيۡ مَعَ الۡقَوۡمِ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa lammaa raja'a Moosaaa ilaa qawmihee ghadbaana asifan qaala bi'samaa khalaftumoonee mim ba'dee a-'ajiltum amra Rabbikum wa alqal alwaaha wa akhaza biraasi akheehi yajurruhoo ilaih; qaalab na umma innal qawmas tad'afoonee wa kadoo yaqtu loonanee; falaa tushmit biyal a'daaa'a wa laa taj'alnee ma'al qawmiz zaalimeen
ayahs.en: And when Moses returned to his people, angry and grieved, he said, "How wretched is that by which you have replaced me after [my departure]. Were you impatient over the matter of your Lord?" And he threw down the tablets and seized his brother by [the hair of] his head, pulling him toward him. [Aaron] said, "O son of my mother, indeed the people oppressed me and were about to kill me, so let not the enemies rejoice over me and do not place me among the wrongdoing people."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ اغۡفِرۡ لِيۡ وَلِاَخِيۡ وَاَدۡخِلۡنَا فِيۡ رَحۡمَتِكَؗۖ وَاَنۡتَ اَرۡحَمُ الرّٰحِمِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaala Rabbigh fir lee wa li akhee wa adkhilnaa fee rahmatika wa Anta arhamur raahimeen
ayahs.en: [Moses] said, "My Lord, forgive me and my brother and admit us into Your mercy, for You are the most merciful of the merciful."

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ اتَّخَذُوا الۡعِجۡلَ سَيَنَالُهُمۡ غَضَبٌ مِّنۡ رَّبِّهِمۡ وَذِلَّةٌ فِي الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَاؕ وَكَذٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي الۡمُفۡتَرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Innal lazeenat takhazul 'ijla-sa yanaaluhum ghadabum mir Rabbihim wa zillatun fil hayaatid dunyaa; wa kazaalika najzil muftareen
ayahs.en: Indeed, those who took the calf [for worship] will obtain anger from their Lord and humiliation in the life of this world, and thus do We recompense the inventors [of falsehood].

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ عَمِلُوا السَّيِّاٰتِ ثُمَّ تَابُوۡا مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِهَا وَاٰمَنُوۡ٘اؗ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِهَا لَغَفُوۡرٌ رَّحِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Wallazeena 'amilus saiyiaati summa taaboo mim ba'dihaa wa aamanooo inna Rabbaka mim ba'dihaa la Ghafoorur Raheem
ayahs.en: But those who committed misdeeds and then repented after them and believed - indeed your Lord, thereafter, is Forgiving and Merciful.

ayahs.ar: وَلَمَّا سَكَتَ عَنۡ مُّوۡسَي الۡغَضَبُ اَخَذَ الۡاَلۡوَاحَۚۖ وَفِيۡ نُسۡخَتِهَا هُدًي وَّرَحۡمَةٌ لِّلَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ لِرَبِّهِمۡ يَرۡهَبُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa lammaa sakata 'am Moosal ghadabu akhazal al waaha wa fee nnuskhatihaa hudanw wa rahmatul lillazeena hum li Rabbihim yarhaboon
ayahs.en: And when the anger subsided in Moses, he took up the tablets; and in their inscription was guidance and mercy for those who are fearful of their Lord.

ayahs.ar: وَاخۡتَارَ مُوۡسٰي قَوۡمَهٗ سَبۡعِيۡنَ رَجُلًا لِّمِيۡقَاتِنَاۚ فَلَمَّا٘ اَخَذَتۡهُمُ الرَّجۡفَةُ قَالَ رَبِّ لَوۡ شِئۡتَ اَهۡلَكۡتَهُمۡ مِّنۡ قَبۡلُ وَاِيَّايَؕ اَتُهۡلِكُنَا بِمَا فَعَلَ السُّفَهَآءُ مِنَّاۚ اِنۡ هِيَ اِلَّا فِتۡنَتُكَؕ تُضِلُّ بِهَا مَنۡ تَشَآءُ وَتَهۡدِيۡ مَنۡ تَشَآءُؕ اَنۡتَ وَلِيُّنَا فَاغۡفِرۡ لَنَا وَارۡحَمۡنَا وَاَنۡتَ خَيۡرُ الۡغٰفِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wakhtaara Moosaa qawmahoo sab'eena rajjulal limeeqaatinaa falammaa akhazat humur rajfatu qaala Rabbi law shi'ta ahlaktahum min qablu wa iyyaaya atuhlikunna bimaa fa'alas sufahaaa'u minnaa in hiya illaa fitnatuka tudillu bihaa man tashaaa'u wa tahdee man tashaaa'u Anta waliyyunaa faghfir lanaa warhammnnaa wa Anta khairul ghaafireen
ayahs.en: And Moses chose from his people seventy men for Our appointment. And when the earthquake seized them, he said, "My Lord, if You had willed, You could have destroyed them before and me [as well]. Would You destroy us for what the foolish among us have done? This is not but Your trial by which You send astray whom You will and guide whom You will. You are our Protector, so forgive us and have mercy upon us; and You are the best of forgivers.

ayahs.ar: وَاكۡتُبۡ لَنَا فِيۡ هٰذِهِ الدُّنۡيَا حَسَنَةً وَّفِي الۡاٰخِرَةِ اِنَّا هُدۡنَا٘ اِلَيۡكَؕ قَالَ عَذَابِيۡ٘ اُصِيۡبُ بِهٖ مَنۡ اَشَآءُۚ وَرَحۡمَتِيۡ وَسِعَتۡ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍؕ فَسَاَكۡتُبُهَا لِلَّذِيۡنَ يَتَّقُوۡنَ وَيُؤۡتُوۡنَ الزَّكٰوةَ وَالَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ بِاٰيٰتِنَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Waktub lanaa fee haazi hid dunyaa hasanatanw wa fil Aakhirati innnaa hudnaaa ilaik; qaala 'azaabee useebu bihee man ashaaa'u wa rahmatee wasi'at kulla shai'; fasa aktubuhaa lillazeena yattaqoona wa yu'toonaz Zakaata wallazeena hum bi Aayaatinaa yu'minoon
ayahs.en: And decree for us in this world [that which is] good and [also] in the Hereafter; indeed, we have turned back to You." [Allah] said, "My punishment - I afflict with it whom I will, but My mercy encompasses all things." So I will decree it [especially] for those who fear Me and give zakah and those who believe in Our verses -

ayahs.ar: اَلَّذِيۡنَ يَتَّبِعُوۡنَ الرَّسُوۡلَ النَّبِيَّ الۡاُمِّيَّ الَّذِيۡ يَجِدُوۡنَهٗ مَكۡتُوۡبًا عِنۡدَهُمۡ فِي التَّوۡرٰىةِ وَالۡاِنۡجِيۡلِؗ يَاۡمُرُهُمۡ بِالۡمَعۡرُوۡفِ وَيَنۡهٰىهُمۡ عَنِ الۡمُنۡكَرِ وَيُحِلُّ لَهُمُ الطَّيِّبٰتِ وَيُحَرِّمُ عَلَيۡهِمُ الۡخَبٰٓئِثَ وَيَضَعُ عَنۡهُمۡ اِصۡرَهُمۡ وَالۡاَغۡلٰلَ الَّتِيۡ كَانَتۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡؕ فَالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا بِهٖ وَعَزَّرُوۡهُ وَنَصَرُوۡهُ وَاتَّبَعُوا النُّوۡرَ الَّذِيۡ٘ اُنۡزِلَ مَعَهٗ٘ۙ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الۡمُفۡلِحُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Allazeena yattabi'oonar Rasoolan Nabiyyal ummiyyal lazee yajidoonahoo maktooban 'indahum fit Tawraati wal Injeeli yaa muruhum bilma'roofi wa yanhaahum 'anil munkari wa yuhillu lahumul taiyibaati wa yuharrimu 'alaihimul khabaaa'isa wa yada'u 'anhum israhum wal aghlaalal latee kaanat 'alaihim; fallazeena aamanoo bihee wa 'azzaroohu wa nnasaroohu wattaba'un nooral lazeee unzila ma'ahooo ulaaa'ika humul muflihoon
ayahs.en: Those who follow the Messenger, the unlettered prophet, whom they find written in what they have of the Torah and the Gospel, who enjoins upon them what is right and forbids them what is wrong and makes lawful for them the good things and prohibits for them the evil and relieves them of their burden and the shackles which were upon them. So they who have believed in him, honored him, supported him and followed the light which was sent down with him - it is those who will be the successful.

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ يٰ٘اَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اِنِّيۡ رَسُوۡلُ اللّٰهِ اِلَيۡكُمۡ جَمِيۡعَا اِۨلَّذِيۡ لَهٗ مُلۡكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِۚ لَا٘ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ يُحۡيٖ وَيُمِيۡتُࣕ فَاٰمِنُوۡا بِاللّٰهِ وَرَسُوۡلِهِ النَّبِيِّ الۡاُمِّيِّ الَّذِيۡ يُؤۡمِنُ بِاللّٰهِ وَكَلِمٰتِهٖ وَاتَّبِعُوۡهُ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَهۡتَدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qul yaaa aiyuhan naasu innee Rasoohul laahi ilaikum jamee'anil lazee lahoo mulkus samaawaati wal ardi laaa ilaaha illaa Huwa yuhyee wa yumeetu fa aaminoo billaahi wa Rasoolihin Nabiyyil ummiy yil lazee yu'minu billaahi wa Kalimaatihee wattabi'oohu la'allakum tahtadoon
ayahs.en: Say, [O Muhammad], "O mankind, indeed I am the Messenger of Allah to you all, [from Him] to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. There is no deity except Him; He gives life and causes death." So believe in Allah and His Messenger, the unlettered prophet, who believes in Allah and His words, and follow him that you may be guided.

ayahs.ar: وَمِنۡ قَوۡمِ مُوۡسٰ٘ي اُمَّةٌ يَّهۡدُوۡنَ بِالۡحَقِّ وَبِهٖ يَعۡدِلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa min qawmi Moosaaa ummatuny yahdoona bilhaqqi wa bihee ya'diloon
ayahs.en: And among the people of Moses is a community which guides by truth and by it establishes justice.

ayahs.ar: وَقَطَّعۡنٰهُمُ اثۡنَتَيۡ عَشۡرَةَ اَسۡبَاطًا اُمَمًاؕ وَاَوۡحَيۡنَا٘ اِلٰي مُوۡسٰ٘ي اِذِ اسۡتَسۡقٰىهُ قَوۡمُهٗ٘ اَنِ اضۡرِبۡ بِّعَصَاكَ الۡحَجَرَۚ فَانۭۡ بَجَسَتۡ مِنۡهُ اثۡنَتَا عَشۡرَةَ عَيۡنًاؕ قَدۡ عَلِمَ كُلُّ اُنَاسٍ مَّشۡرَبَهُمۡؕ وَظَلَّلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمُ الۡغَمَامَ وَاَنۡزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمُ الۡمَنَّ وَالسَّلۡوٰيؕ كُلُوۡا مِنۡ طَيِّبٰتِ مَا رَزَقۡنٰكُمۡؕ وَمَا ظَلَمُوۡنَا وَلٰكِنۡ كَانُوۡ٘ا اَنۡفُسَهُمۡ يَظۡلِمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa qatta' naahumus natai 'ashrata asbaatan umamaa; wa awhainaa ilaa Moosaaa izis tasqaahu qawmuhooo anid rib bi'asaakal hajara fambajasat minhus nata 'ashrata 'ainan qad 'alima kullu unaasim mashrabahm; wa zallalnaa 'alaihimul ghammaamma wa anzalnaa 'alaihimul MManna was Salwaa kuloo min taiyibaati maa razaqnaakum; wa maa zalamoonaa wa laakin kaanooo anfusahum yazlimoon
ayahs.en: And We divided them into twelve descendant tribes [as distinct] nations. And We inspired to Moses when his people implored him for water, "Strike with your staff the stone," and there gushed forth from it twelve springs. Every people knew its watering place. And We shaded them with clouds and sent down upon them manna and quails, [saying], "Eat from the good things with which We have provided you." And they wronged Us not, but they were [only] wronging themselves.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذۡ قِيۡلَ لَهُمُ اسۡكُنُوۡا هٰذِهِ الۡقَرۡيَةَ وَكُلُوۡا مِنۡهَا حَيۡثُ شِئۡتُمۡ وَقُوۡلُوۡا حِطَّةٌ وَّادۡخُلُوا الۡبَابَ سُجَّدًا نَّغۡفِرۡ لَكُمۡ خَطِيۡٓـٰٔتِكُمۡؕ سَنَزِيۡدُ الۡمُحۡسِنِيۡنَ
