ayahs.tl: Wa iz qeela lahumuskunoo haazihil qaryata wa kuloo minhaa haisu shi'tum wa qooloo hittatunw wadkhulul baaba sujjadan naghfir lakum khateee'aatikum; sanazeedul muhsineen
ayahs.en: And [mention, O Muhammad], when it was said to them, "Dwell in this city and eat from it wherever you will and say, 'Relieve us of our burdens,' and enter the gate bowing humbly; We will [then] forgive you your sins. We will increase the doers of good [in goodness and reward]."

ayahs.ar: فَبَدَّلَ الَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡا مِنۡهُمۡ قَوۡلًا غَيۡرَ الَّذِيۡ قِيۡلَ لَهُمۡ فَاَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ رِجۡزًا مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ بِمَا كَانُوۡا يَظۡلِمُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Fabaddalal lazeena zalamoo minhum qawlan ghairal lazee qeela lahum fa arsalnaa 'alaihim rijzam minas samaaa'i bimaa kaanoo yazlimoon
ayahs.en: But those who wronged among them changed [the words] to a statement other than that which had been said to them. So We sent upon them a punishment from the sky for the wrong that they were doing.

ayahs.ar: وَسۡـَٔلۡهُمۡ عَنِ الۡقَرۡيَةِ الَّتِيۡ كَانَتۡ حَاضِرَةَ الۡبَحۡرِۘ اِذۡ يَعۡدُوۡنَ فِي السَّبۡتِ اِذۡ تَاۡتِيۡهِمۡ حِيۡتَانُهُمۡ يَوۡمَ سَبۡتِهِمۡ شُرَّعًا وَّيَوۡمَ لَا يَسۡبِتُوۡنَۙ لَا تَاۡتِيۡهِمۡۚۛ كَذٰلِكَۚۛ نَبۡلُوۡهُمۡ بِمَا كَانُوۡا يَفۡسُقُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Was'alhum 'anil qaryatil latee kaanat haadiratal bahri iz ya'doona fis Sabt iz taateehim heetaanuhum yawma Sabtihim shurra'anw wa yawma laa yasbitoona laa taateehim; kazaalika nabloohum bimaa kaanoo yafsuqoon
ayahs.en: And ask them about the town that was by the sea - when they transgressed in [the matter of] the sabbath - when their fish came to them openly on their sabbath day, and the day they had no sabbath they did not come to them. Thus did We give them trial because they were defiantly disobedient.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذۡ قَالَتۡ اُمَّةٌ مِّنۡهُمۡ لِمَ تَعِظُوۡنَ قَوۡمَاۙ اِۨللّٰهُ مُهۡلِكُهُمۡ اَوۡ مُعَذِّبُهُمۡ عَذَابًا شَدِيۡدًاؕ قَالُوۡا مَعۡذِرَةً اِلٰي رَبِّكُمۡ وَلَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَّقُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa iz qaalat ummatum minhum lima ta'izoona qaw manil laahu muhlikuhum aw mu'azzibuhum 'azaaban shadeedan qaaloo ma'ziratan ilaa Rabbikum wa la'allahum tattaqoon
ayahs.en: And when a community among them said, "Why do you advise [or warn] a people whom Allah is [about] to destroy or to punish with a severe punishment?" they [the advisors] said, "To be absolved before your Lord and perhaps they may fear Him."

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا نَسُوۡا مَا ذُكِّرُوۡا بِهٖ٘ اَنۡجَيۡنَا الَّذِيۡنَ يَنۡهَوۡنَ عَنِ السُّوۡٓءِ وَاَخَذۡنَا الَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡا بِعَذَابٍۭ بَـِٕيۡسٍۭ بِمَا كَانُوۡا يَفۡسُقُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Falammaa nasoo maa zukkiroo bihee anjainal lazeena yanhawna 'anis sooo'i wa akhaznal lazeena zalamoo bi'azaabim ba'eeim bimaa kaanooyafsuqoon
ayahs.en: And when they forgot that by which they had been reminded, We saved those who had forbidden evil and seized those who wronged, with a wretched punishment, because they were defiantly disobeying.

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا عَتَوۡا عَنۡ مَّا نُهُوۡا عَنۡهُ قُلۡنَا لَهُمۡ كُوۡنُوۡا قِرَدَةً خٰسِـِٕيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Falammaa 'ataw 'ammmaa nuhoo 'anhu qulna lahum kkoonoo qiradatan khaasi'een
ayahs.en: So when they were insolent about that which they had been forbidden, We said to them, "Be apes, despised."

ayahs.ar: وَاِذۡ تَاَذَّنَ رَبُّكَ لَيَبۡعَثَنَّ عَلَيۡهِمۡ اِلٰي يَوۡمِ الۡقِيٰمَةِ مَنۡ يَّسُوۡمُهُمۡ سُوۡٓءَ الۡعَذَابِؕ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَسَرِيۡعُ الۡعِقَابِۚۖ وَاِنَّهٗ لَغَفُوۡرٌ رَّحِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa iz ta azzana Rabbuka la yab'asannna 'alaihim ilaa Yawmil Qiyaamati mai yasoomuhum sooo'al 'azaab; inna Rabbaka lasaree'ul 'iqaab; wa innahoo la Ghafoorur Raheem
ayahs.en: And [mention] when your Lord declared that He would surely [continue to] send upon them until the Day of Resurrection those who would afflict them with the worst torment. Indeed, your Lord is swift in penalty; but indeed, He is Forgiving and Merciful.

ayahs.ar: وَقَطَّعۡنٰهُمۡ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ اُمَمًاۚ مِنۡهُمُ الصّٰلِحُوۡنَ وَمِنۡهُمۡ دُوۡنَ ذٰلِكَؗ وَبَلَوۡنٰهُمۡ بِالۡحَسَنٰتِ وَالسَّيِّاٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa qatta'naahum fil ardi umamam minhumus aalihoona wa min hum doona zaalika wa balawnaahum bilhasanaati wassaiyi aati la'allahum yarji'oon
ayahs.en: And We divided them throughout the earth into nations. Of them some were righteous, and of them some were otherwise. And We tested them with good [times] and bad that perhaps they would return [to obedience].

ayahs.ar: فَخَلَفَ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِهِمۡ خَلۡفٌ وَّرِثُوا الۡكِتٰبَ يَاۡخُذُوۡنَ عَرَضَ هٰذَا الۡاَدۡنٰي وَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ سَيُغۡفَرُ لَنَاۚ وَاِنۡ يَّاۡتِهِمۡ عَرَضٌ مِّثۡلُهٗ يَاۡخُذُوۡهُؕ اَلَمۡ يُؤۡخَذۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ مِّيۡثَاقُ الۡكِتٰبِ اَنۡ لَّا يَقُوۡلُوۡا عَلَي اللّٰهِ اِلَّا الۡحَقَّ وَدَرَسُوۡا مَا فِيۡهِؕ وَالدَّارُ الۡاٰخِرَةُ خَيۡرٌ لِّلَّذِيۡنَ يَتَّقُوۡنَؕ اَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fakhalafa mim ba'dihim khalfunw warisul Kitaaba yaa khuzoona 'arada haazal adnaa wa yaqooloona sayughfaru lanaa wa iny yaatihim 'aradum misluhoo yaakhuzooh; alam yu'khaz 'alaihim 'aradum misluhoo yaakhuzooh; alam yu'khaz 'alaihim meesaaqul Kitaabi al laa yaqooloo 'alal laahi illal haqqa wa darasoo maa feeh; wad Daarul Aakhirtu khairul lillazeena yattaqoon; afalaa ta'qiloon
ayahs.en: And there followed them successors who inherited the Scripture [while] taking the commodities of this lower life and saying, "It will be forgiven for us." And if an offer like it comes to them, they will [again] take it. Was not the covenant of the Scripture taken from them that they would not say about Allah except the truth, and they studied what was in it? And the home of the Hereafter is better for those who fear Allah, so will you not use reason?

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ يُمَسِّكُوۡنَ بِالۡكِتٰبِ وَاَقَامُوا الصَّلٰوةَؕ اِنَّا لَا نُضِيۡعُ اَجۡرَ الۡمُصۡلِحِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wallazeena yumas sikoona bil Kitaabi wa aqaamus Salaata innaa laa nudee'uajral musliheen
ayahs.en: But those who hold fast to the Book and establish prayer - indeed, We will not allow to be lost the reward of the reformers.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذۡ نَتَقۡنَا الۡجَبَلَ فَوۡقَهُمۡ كَاَنَّهٗ ظُلَّةٌ وَّظَنُّوۡ٘ا اَنَّهٗ وَاقِعٌۭ بِهِمۡۚ خُذُوۡا مَا٘ اٰتَيۡنٰكُمۡ بِقُوَّةٍ وَّاذۡكُرُوۡا مَا فِيۡهِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَتَّقُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa iz nataqnal jabala fawqahum ka annahoo zullatunw wa zannooo annahoo waaqi'um bihim khuzoo maaa aatainaakum biquwwatinw wazkuroo maa feehi la'allakum tattaqoon
ayahs.en: And [mention] when We raised the mountain above them as if it was a dark cloud and they were certain that it would fall upon them, [and Allah said], "Take what We have given you with determination and remember what is in it that you might fear Allah."

ayahs.ar: وَاِذۡ اَخَذَ رَبُّكَ مِنۭۡ بَنِيۡ٘ اٰدَمَ مِنۡ ظُهُوۡرِهِمۡ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمۡ وَاَشۡهَدَهُمۡ عَلٰ٘ي اَنۡفُسِهِمۡۚ اَلَسۡتُ بِرَبِّكُمۡؕ قَالُوۡا بَلٰيۚۛ شَهِدۡنَاۚۛ اَنۡ تَقُوۡلُوۡا يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ اِنَّا كُنَّا عَنۡ هٰذَا غٰفِلِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa iz akhaza Rabbuka mim Baneee Aadama min zuhoorihim zurriyyatahum wa ash hadahum 'alaa anfusihim alastu bi Rabbikum qaaloo balaa shahidnaaa; an taqooloo Yawmal Qiyaamati innaa kunnaa 'an haazaa ghaafileen
ayahs.en: And [mention] when your Lord took from the children of Adam - from their loins - their descendants and made them testify of themselves, [saying to them], "Am I not your Lord?" They said, "Yes, we have testified." [This] - lest you should say on the day of Resurrection, "Indeed, we were of this unaware."

ayahs.ar: اَوۡ تَقُوۡلُوۡ٘ا اِنَّمَا٘ اَشۡرَكَ اٰبَآؤُنَا مِنۡ قَبۡلُ وَكُنَّا ذُرِّيَّةً مِّنۭۡ بَعۡدِهِمۡۚ اَفَتُهۡلِكُنَا بِمَا فَعَلَ الۡمُبۡطِلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Aw taqoolooo innamaaa ashraka aabaaa 'unaa min qablu wa kunnaa zurriyyatam mim ba'dihim afatuhlikunna bimaa fa'alal mubtiloon
ayahs.en: Or [lest] you say, "It was only that our fathers associated [others in worship] with Allah before, and we were but descendants after them. Then would You destroy us for what the falsifiers have done?"

ayahs.ar: وَكَذٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ الۡاٰيٰتِ وَلَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa kazaalika nufassihul Aayaati wa la'allahum yarji'oon
ayahs.en: And thus do We [explain in] detail the verses, and perhaps they will return.

ayahs.ar: وَاتۡلُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ نَبَاَ الَّذِيۡ٘ اٰتَيۡنٰهُ اٰيٰتِنَا فَانۡسَلَخَ مِنۡهَا فَاَتۡبَعَهُ الشَّيۡطٰنُ فَكَانَ مِنَ الۡغٰوِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Watlu 'alaihim naba allazeee aatainaahu Aayaatinaa fansalakha minhaa fa atba'a hush Shaytaano fakaana minal ghaaween
ayahs.en: And recite to them, [O Muhammad], the news of him to whom we gave [knowledge of] Our signs, but he detached himself from them; so Satan pursued him, and he became of the deviators.

ayahs.ar: وَلَوۡ شِئۡنَا لَرَفَعۡنٰهُ بِهَا وَلٰكِنَّهٗ٘ اَخۡلَدَ اِلَي الۡاَرۡضِ وَاتَّبَعَ هَوٰىهُۚ فَمَثَلُهٗ كَمَثَلِ الۡكَلۡبِۚ اِنۡ تَحۡمِلۡ عَلَيۡهِ يَلۡهَثۡ اَوۡ تَتۡرُكۡهُ يَلۡهَثۡؕ ذٰلِكَ مَثَلُ الۡقَوۡمِ الَّذِيۡنَ كَذَّبُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِنَاۚ فَاقۡصُصِ الۡقَصَصَ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَفَكَّرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa law shi'naa larafa'naahu bihaa wa laakin nahooo akhlada ilal ardi watta ba'a hawaah; famasaluhoo kamasalil kalb; in tahmil 'alaihi yalhas aw tatruk hu yalhas; zaalika masalul qawmil lazeena kazzaboo bi Aayaatinaa; faqsusil qasasa la'allahum yatafakkaroon
ayahs.en: And if We had willed, we could have elevated him thereby, but he adhered [instead] to the earth and followed his own desire. So his example is like that of the dog: if you chase him, he pants, or if you leave him, he [still] pants. That is the example of the people who denied Our signs. So relate the stories that perhaps they will give thought.

ayahs.ar: سَآءَ مَثَلَا اِۨلۡقَوۡمُ الَّذِيۡنَ كَذَّبُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِنَا وَاَنۡفُسَهُمۡ كَانُوۡا يَظۡلِمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Saaa'a masalanil qawmul lazeena kazzaboo bi Aayaatinaa wa anfusahum kaanoo yazlimoon
ayahs.en: How evil an example [is that of] the people who denied Our signs and used to wrong themselves.

ayahs.ar: مَنۡ يَّهۡدِ اللّٰهُ فَهُوَ الۡمُهۡتَدِيۡۚ وَمَنۡ يُّضۡلِلۡ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الۡخٰسِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: mai yahdil laahu fa huwal muhtadee wa mai yudlil fa ulaaa'ika humul khaasiroon
ayahs.en: Whoever Allah guides - he is the [rightly] guided; and whoever He sends astray - it is those who are the losers.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ ذَرَاۡنَا لِجَهَنَّمَ كَثِيۡرًا مِّنَ الۡجِنِّ وَالۡاِنۡسِؗۖ لَهُمۡ قُلُوۡبٌ لَّا يَفۡقَهُوۡنَ بِهَاؗ وَلَهُمۡ اَعۡيُنٌ لَّا يُبۡصِرُوۡنَ بِهَاؗ وَلَهُمۡ اٰذَانٌ لَّا يَسۡمَعُوۡنَ بِهَاؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ كَالۡاَنۡعَامِ بَلۡ هُمۡ اَضَلُّؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الۡغٰفِلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad zaraanaa li jahannama kaseeram minal jinni wal insi lahum quloobul laa yafqahoona bihaa wa lahum a'yunul laa yubisiroona bihaa wa lahum aazaanul laa yasma'oona bihaa; ulaaa'ika kal an'aami bal hum adall; ulaaa'ika humul ghaafiloon
ayahs.en: And We have certainly created for Hell many of the jinn and mankind. They have hearts with which they do not understand, they have eyes with which they do not see, and they have ears with which they do not hear. Those are like livestock; rather, they are more astray. It is they who are the heedless.

ayahs.ar: وَلِلّٰهِ الۡاَسۡمَآءُ الۡحُسۡنٰي فَادۡعُوۡهُ بِهَاࣕ وَذَرُوا الَّذِيۡنَ يُلۡحِدُوۡنَ فِيۡ٘ اَسۡمَآئِهٖؕ سَيُجۡزَوۡنَ مَا كَانُوۡا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa lillaahil Asmaaa 'ul Husnaa fad'oohu bihaa wa zarul lazeena yulhidoona feee Asmaaa'ih; sa yujzawna maa kaanoo ya'maloon
ayahs.en: And to Allah belong the best names, so invoke Him by them. And leave [the company of] those who practice deviation concerning His names. They will be recompensed for what they have been doing.

ayahs.ar: وَمِمَّنۡ خَلَقۡنَا٘ اُمَّةٌ يَّهۡدُوۡنَ بِالۡحَقِّ وَبِهٖ يَعۡدِلُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa mimman khalaqnaaa ummatuny yahdoona bilhaqqi wa bihee ya'diloon
ayahs.en: And among those We created is a community which guides by truth and thereby establishes justice.

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ كَذَّبُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِنَا سَنَسۡتَدۡرِجُهُمۡ مِّنۡ حَيۡثُ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wallazeena kazzaboo bi Aayaatinaa sanastadrijuhum min haisu laa ya'lamoon
ayahs.en: But those who deny Our signs - We will progressively lead them [to destruction] from where they do not know.

ayahs.ar: وَاُمۡلِيۡ لَهُمۡؕ اِنَّ كَيۡدِيۡ مَتِيۡنٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa umlee lahum; inna kaidee mateen
ayahs.en: And I will give them time. Indeed, my plan is firm.

ayahs.ar: اَوَلَمۡ يَتَفَكَّرُوۡاࣝ مَا بِصَاحِبِهِمۡ مِّنۡ جِنَّةٍؕ اِنۡ هُوَ اِلَّا نَذِيۡرٌ مُّبِيۡنٌ
ayahs.tl: Awalam yatafakkaroo maa bisaahibihim min jinnah; in huwa illaa nazeerum mubeen
ayahs.en: Then do they not give thought? There is in their companion [Muhammad] no madness. He is not but a clear warner.

ayahs.ar: اَوَلَمۡ يَنۡظُرُوۡا فِيۡ مَلَكُوۡتِ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا خَلَقَ اللّٰهُ مِنۡ شَيۡءٍۙ وَّاَنۡ عَسٰ٘ي اَنۡ يَّكُوۡنَ قَدِ اقۡتَرَبَ اَجَلُهُمۡۚ فَبِاَيِّ حَدِيۡثٍۭ بَعۡدَهٗ يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Awalam yanzuroo fee malakootis samaawaati wal ardi wa maa khalaqal laahu min shai'inw wa an 'asaaa ai yakoona qadiqtaraba ajaluhum fabi aiyi hadeesim ba'dahoo yu'minoon
ayahs.en: Do they not look into the realm of the heavens and the earth and everything that Allah has created and [think] that perhaps their appointed time has come near? So in what statement hereafter will they believe?

ayahs.ar: مَنۡ يُّضۡلِلِ اللّٰهُ فَلَا هَادِيَ لَهٗؕ وَيَذَرُهُمۡ فِيۡ طُغۡيَانِهِمۡ يَعۡمَهُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Mai yadlilil laahu falaa haadiyaa lah; wa yazaruhum fee tughyaanihim ya'mahoon
ayahs.en: Whoever Allah sends astray - there is no guide for him. And He leaves them in their transgression, wandering blindly.

ayahs.ar: يَسۡـَٔلُوۡنَكَ عَنِ السَّاعَةِ اَيَّانَ مُرۡسٰىهَاؕ قُلۡ اِنَّمَا عِلۡمُهَا عِنۡدَ رَبِّيۡۚ لَا يُجَلِّيۡهَا لِوَقۡتِهَا٘ اِلَّا هُوَۘؕؔ ثَقُلَتۡ فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِؕ لَا تَاۡتِيۡكُمۡ اِلَّا بَغۡتَةًؕ يَسۡـَٔلُوۡنَكَ كَاَنَّكَ حَفِيٌّ عَنۡهَاؕ قُلۡ اِنَّمَا عِلۡمُهَا عِنۡدَ اللّٰهِ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Yas'aloonaka 'anis Saa'ati aiyaana mursaahaa qul innamaa 'ilmuhaa 'inda Rabbee laa yujallaeehaa liwaqtihaaa illaa Hoo; saqulat fis samaawaati wal ard; laa taateekum illaa baghtah; yas'aloonaka ka annaka hafiyyun 'anhaa qul innamaa 'ilmuhaa 'indal laahi wa laakinna aksaran naasi laa ya'lamoon
ayahs.en: They ask you, [O Muhammad], about the Hour: when is its arrival? Say, "Its knowledge is only with my Lord. None will reveal its time except Him. It lays heavily upon the heavens and the earth. It will not come upon you except unexpectedly." They ask you as if you are familiar with it. Say, "Its knowledge is only with Allah, but most of the people do not know."

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ لَّا٘ اَمۡلِكُ لِنَفۡسِيۡ نَفۡعًا وَّلَا ضَرًّا اِلَّا مَا شَآءَ اللّٰهُؕ وَلَوۡ كُنۡتُ اَعۡلَمُ الۡغَيۡبَ لَاسۡتَكۡثَرۡتُ مِنَ الۡخَيۡرِۚۛ وَمَا مَسَّنِيَ السُّوۡٓءُۚۛ اِنۡ اَنَا اِلَّا نَذِيۡرٌ وَّبَشِيۡرٌ لِّقَوۡمٍ يُّؤۡمِنُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Qul laaa amliku linafsee naf'anw wa laa darran illaa maa shaaa'al laah; wa law kuntu a'alamul ghaiba lastaksartu minal khairi wa maa massaniyas soo'; in ana illaa nazeerunw wa basheerul liqawminy yu'minoon
ayahs.en: Say, "I hold not for myself [the power of] benefit or harm, except what Allah has willed. And if I knew the unseen, I could have acquired much wealth, and no harm would have touched me. I am not except a warner and a bringer of good tidings to a people who believe."

ayahs.ar: هُوَ الَّذِيۡ خَلَقَكُمۡ مِّنۡ نَّفۡسٍ وَّاحِدَةٍ وَّجَعَلَ مِنۡهَا زَوۡجَهَا لِيَسۡكُنَ اِلَيۡهَاۚ فَلَمَّا تَغَشّٰىهَا حَمَلَتۡ حَمۡلًا خَفِيۡفًا فَمَرَّتۡ بِهٖۚ فَلَمَّا٘ اَثۡقَلَتۡ دَّعَوَا اللّٰهَ رَبَّهُمَا لَئِنۡ اٰتَيۡتَنَا صَالِحًا لَّنَكُوۡنَنَّ مِنَ الشّٰكِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Huwal lazee khalaqakum min nafsinw waahidatinw wa ja'ala minhaa zawjahaa liyas kuna ilaihaa falammaa taghash shaahaa hamalat hamlan khafeefan famarrat bihee falammaaa asqalad da'awal laaha Rabbahumaa la'in aayaitanaa saalihal lanakoo nanna minash shaakireen
ayahs.en: It is He who created you from one soul and created from it its mate that he might dwell in security with her. And when he covers her, she carries a light burden and continues therein. And when it becomes heavy, they both invoke Allah, their Lord, "If You should give us a good [child], we will surely be among the grateful."

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا٘ اٰتٰىهُمَا صَالِحًا جَعَلَا لَهٗ شُرَكَآءَ فِيۡمَا٘ اٰتٰىهُمَاۚ فَتَعٰلَي اللّٰهُ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Falammaaa aataahumaa saalihan ja'alaa lahoo shurakaaa'a feemaaa aataahumaa; fata'aalal laahu 'ammaa yushrikoon
ayahs.en: But when He gives them a good [child], they ascribe partners to Him concerning that which He has given them. Exalted is Allah above what they associate with Him.

ayahs.ar: اَيُشۡرِكُوۡنَ مَا لَا يَخۡلُقُ شَيۡـًٔا وَّهُمۡ يُخۡلَقُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: A yushrikoona maa laa yakhluqu shai'anw wa hum yukhlaqoon
ayahs.en: Do they associate with Him those who create nothing and they are [themselves] created?

ayahs.ar: وَلَا يَسۡتَطِيۡعُوۡنَ لَهُمۡ نَصۡرًا وَّلَا٘ اَنۡفُسَهُمۡ يَنۡصُرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa laa yastatee'oona lahum nasranw wa laaa anfusahum yansuroon
ayahs.en: And the false deities are unable to [give] them help, nor can they help themselves.

ayahs.ar: وَاِنۡ تَدۡعُوۡهُمۡ اِلَي الۡهُدٰي لَا يَتَّبِعُوۡكُمۡؕ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡكُمۡ اَدَعَوۡتُمُوۡهُمۡ اَمۡ اَنۡتُمۡ صَامِتُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa in tad'oohum ilalhudaa laa yattabi'ookum; sawaaa'un 'alaikum a-da'awtumoohum am antum saamitoon
ayahs.en: And if you [believers] invite them to guidance, they will not follow you. It is all the same for you whether you invite them or you are silent.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ تَدۡعُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ عِبَادٌ اَمۡثَالُكُمۡ فَادۡعُوۡهُمۡ فَلۡيَسۡتَجِيۡبُوۡا لَكُمۡ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ صٰدِقِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Innal lazeena tad'oona min doonil laahi 'ibaadun amsaalukum fad'oohum fal yastajeeboo lakum in kuntum saadiqeen
ayahs.en: Indeed, those you [polytheists] call upon besides Allah are servants like you. So call upon them and let them respond to you, if you should be truthful.

ayahs.ar: اَلَهُمۡ اَرۡجُلٌ يَّمۡشُوۡنَ بِهَا٘ؗ اَمۡ لَهُمۡ اَيۡدٍ يَّبۡطِشُوۡنَ بِهَا٘ؗ اَمۡ لَهُمۡ اَعۡيُنٌ يُّبۡصِرُوۡنَ بِهَا٘ؗ اَمۡ لَهُمۡ اٰذَانٌ يَّسۡمَعُوۡنَ بِهَاؕ قُلِ ادۡعُوۡا شُرَكَآءَكُمۡ ثُمَّ كِيۡدُوۡنِ فَلَا تُنۡظِرُوۡنِ
ayahs.tl: A lahum arjuluny yamshoona bihaa am lahum aidiny yabtishoona bihaaa am lahum a'yunuy yubsiroona bihaaa am lahum aazaanuny yasma'oona bihaa; qulid'oo shurakaaa'akum summa keedooni falaa tunziroon
ayahs.en: Do they have feet by which they walk? Or do they have hands by which they strike? Or do they have eyes by which they see? Or do they have ears by which they hear? Say, [O Muhammad], "Call your 'partners' and then conspire against me and give me no respite.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ وَلِيِّۦَ اللّٰهُ الَّذِيۡ نَزَّلَ الۡكِتٰبَؗۖ وَهُوَ يَتَوَلَّي الصّٰلِحِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Inna waliyyial laahul lazee nazzalal Kitaaba wa Huwa yatawallas saaliheen
ayahs.en: Indeed, my protector is Allah, who has sent down the Book; and He is an ally to the righteous.

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ تَدۡعُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ لَا يَسۡتَطِيۡعُوۡنَ نَصۡرَكُمۡ وَلَا٘ اَنۡفُسَهُمۡ يَنۡصُرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wallazeena tad'oona min doonihee laa yastatee'oona nasrakum wa laaa anfusahum yansuroon
ayahs.en: And those you call upon besides Him are unable to help you, nor can they help themselves."

ayahs.ar: وَاِنۡ تَدۡعُوۡهُمۡ اِلَي الۡهُدٰي لَا يَسۡمَعُوۡاؕ وَتَرٰىهُمۡ يَنۡظُرُوۡنَ اِلَيۡكَ وَهُمۡ لَا يُبۡصِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa in tad'oohum ilal hudaa laa yasm'oo wa taraahum yanzuroona ilaika wa hum laa yubsiroon
ayahs.en: And if you invite them to guidance, they do not hear; and you see them looking at you while they do not see.

ayahs.ar: خُذِ الۡعَفۡوَ وَاۡمُرۡ بِالۡعُرۡفِ وَاَعۡرِضۡ عَنِ الۡجٰهِلِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: khuzil 'afwa waamur bil'urfi waa'rid 'anil jaahileen
ayahs.en: Take what is given freely, enjoin what is good, and turn away from the ignorant.

ayahs.ar: وَاِمَّا يَنۡزَغَنَّكَ مِنَ الشَّيۡطٰنِ نَزۡغٌ فَاسۡتَعِذۡ بِاللّٰهِؕ اِنَّهٗ سَمِيۡعٌ عَلِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa immaa yanzaghannaka minash Shaitaani nazghun fasta'iz billaah; innahoo Samee'un Aleem
ayahs.en: And if an evil suggestion comes to you from Satan, then seek refuge in Allah. Indeed, He is Hearing and Knowing.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ اتَّقَوۡا اِذَا مَسَّهُمۡ طٰٓئِفٌ مِّنَ الشَّيۡطٰنِ تَذَكَّرُوۡا فَاِذَا هُمۡ مُّبۡصِرُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Innal lazeenat taqaw izaa massahum taaa'ifum minash Shaitaani tazakkaroo fa izaa hum mubsiroon
ayahs.en: Indeed, those who fear Allah - when an impulse touches them from Satan, they remember [Him] and at once they have insight.

ayahs.ar: وَاِخۡوَانُهُمۡ يَمُدُّوۡنَهُمۡ فِي الۡغَيِّ ثُمَّ لَا يُقۡصِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa ikhwaanuhum yamuddoonahum fil ghaiyi summa laa yuqsiroon
ayahs.en: But their brothers - the devils increase them in error; then they do not stop short.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذَا لَمۡ تَاۡتِهِمۡ بِاٰيَةٍ قَالُوۡا لَوۡلَا اجۡتَبَيۡتَهَاؕ قُلۡ اِنَّمَا٘ اَتَّبِعُ مَا يُوۡحٰ٘ي اِلَيَّ مِنۡ رَّبِّيۡۚ هٰذَا بَصَآئِرُ مِنۡ رَّبِّكُمۡ وَهُدًي وَّرَحۡمَةٌ لِّقَوۡمٍ يُّؤۡمِنُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa izaa lam taatihim bi aayatin qaaloo law lajtabai tahaa; qul innamaaa attabi'u maa yoohaaa ilaiya mir Rabbee; haazaa basaaa'iru mir Rabbikum wa hudanw wa rahmatul liqawminy yu'minoon
ayahs.en: And when you, [O Muhammad], do not bring them a sign, they say, "Why have you not contrived it?" Say, "I only follow what is revealed to me from my Lord. This [Qur'an] is enlightenment from your Lord and guidance and mercy for a people who believe."

ayahs.ar: وَاِذَا قُرِئَ الۡقُرۡاٰنُ فَاسۡتَمِعُوۡا لَهٗ وَاَنۡصِتُوۡا لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُرۡحَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa izaa quri'al Quraanu fastami'oo lahoo wa ansitoo la 'allakum turhamoon
ayahs.en: So when the Qur'an is recited, then listen to it and pay attention that you may receive mercy.

ayahs.ar: وَاذۡكُرۡ رَّبَّكَ فِيۡ نَفۡسِكَ تَضَرُّعًا وَّخِيۡفَةً وَّدُوۡنَ الۡجَهۡرِ مِنَ الۡقَوۡلِ بِالۡغُدُوِّ وَالۡاٰصَالِ وَلَا تَكُنۡ مِّنَ الۡغٰفِلِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wazkur Rabbaka fee nafsika tadarru'anw wa kheefatanw wa doonal jahri minal qawli bilghuduwwi wal aasali wa laa takum minal ghaafileen
ayahs.en: And remember your Lord within yourself in humility and in fear without being apparent in speech - in the mornings and the evenings. And do not be among the heedless.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ عِنۡدَ رَبِّكَ لَا يَسۡتَكۡبِرُوۡنَ عَنۡ عِبَادَتِهٖ وَيُسَبِّحُوۡنَهٗ وَلَهٗ يَسۡجُدُوۡنَࣛࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Innal lazeena 'inda Rabbika laa yastakbiroona 'an 'ibaadatihee wa yusabbihoonahoo wa lahoo yasjudoon
ayahs.en: Indeed, those who are near your Lord are not prevented by arrogance from His worship, and they exalt Him, and to Him they prostrate.
